/-!
# Finite inherited cap tables on one historical mesh

The cell data below are fixed before the target `N`.  The same half-open
mesh is used at ranks three, four and five; an ancestor cell is the literal
initial coordinate projection.  An unselected fourth or fifth cell keeps
its inherited cap, including outside the ambient cube.

The Boolean check in this file checks only finite level comparisons.  It
does not assert square/envelope licensing, certificate integral values,
physical support, distribution, or the final manuscript constants.  The
actual third-to-fifth identity follows from these finite comparisons and
the already proved historical-tree theorem.  Both old and new own-cube
indicators remain in that theorem's fifth saving.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open scoped Classical BigOperators

theorem historicalPrefixProject_comp {α : Type*} {r d e : ℕ}
    (hrd : r ≤ d) (hde : d ≤ e) (t : Fin e → α) :
    historicalPrefixProject hrd (historicalPrefixProject hde t) =
      historicalPrefixProject (hrd.trans hde) t := by
  funext i
  rfl

/-- Half-open ownership identifies the ancestor cell uniquely, including
points on internal grid faces. -/
theorem historicalPrefixAncestorCell_unique {r d m : ℕ}
    (hrd : r ≤ d) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    {j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)} {q : Fin r → Fin (m + 1)}
    {t : Fin d → ℝ} (ht : t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell a b m j)
    (hq : historicalPrefixProject hrd t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell a b m q) :
    q = historicalPrefixProject hrd j :=
  logPrimeMeshCell_unique hab hq (mem_logPrimeMeshCell_historicalPrefixProject hrd ht)

/-- Finite cell comparisons imply monotonicity once the inherited value
has been identified on the selected cell. -/
theorem historicalPrefixLookup_ge_fallback {d : ℕ} (a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (old cap : (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)) → ℚ) (fallback : ℚ) (t : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hlevel : ∀ j ∈ J, old j ≤ cap j)
    (hinherit : ∀ j ∈ J,
      t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j → fallback = old j) :
    fallback ≤ historicalPrefixLookup a b m J cap fallback t := by
  unfold historicalPrefixLookup
  apply le_add_of_nonneg_right
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j hj
  split_ifs with ht
  · rw [hinherit j hj ht]
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (hlevel j hj)
  · exact le_rfl

/-- Exact finite decomposition for any function of the cap.  No
continuity, level ordering or own-cube admission is required. -/
theorem historicalPrefixLookup_apply_sub {d : ℕ} (a b : ℚ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (m : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (cap : (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)) → ℚ) (fallback : ℚ) (t : Fin d → ℝ)
    (f : ℚ → ℝ) :
    f (historicalPrefixLookup a b m J cap fallback t) - f fallback =
      ∑ j ∈ J, if t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j then
        f (cap j) - f fallback else 0 := by
  by_cases hex : ∃ j ∈ J, t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j
  · obtain ⟨j, hj, ht⟩ := hex
    have hsum : (∑ q ∈ J,
        if t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m q then
          f (cap q) - f fallback else 0) = f (cap j) - f fallback := by
      calc
        _ = (if t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j then
            f (cap j) - f fallback else 0) := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem j hj
          intro q _hq hqj
          apply if_neg
          intro hq
          exact hqj (logPrimeMeshCell_unique (by exact_mod_cast hab) hq ht)
        _ = _ := if_pos ht
    rw [historicalPrefixLookup_on_cell a b hab m J cap fallback t j hj ht, hsum]
  · have hout : ∀ j ∈ J, t ∉ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j := by
      simpa only [not_exists, not_and] using hex
    rw [historicalPrefixLookup_outside a b m J cap fallback t hout, sub_self]
    symm
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j hj => if_neg (hout j hj))

namespace HistoricalPrefixCapData

def old4 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (j : Fin 4 → Fin (D.m + 1)) : ℚ :=
  D.cell3 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) j)

def cell4 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (j : Fin 4 → Fin (D.m + 1)) : ℚ :=
  if j ∈ D.cells4 then D.cap4 j else D.old4 j

def old5 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)) : ℚ :=
  D.cell4 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) j)

def cell5 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)) : ℚ :=
  if j ∈ D.cells5 then D.cap5 j else D.old5 j

/-- Only level comparisons are checked here.  The bounded deciders
explicitly traverse the selected finsets, not the full cell-label types.
Square/envelope licenses and numerical integral bounds remain separate
obligations. -/
def levelCheck (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) : Bool :=
  @decide _ (Finset.decidableDforallFinset (s := D.cells3)
    (p := fun j _ => D.old ≤ D.cap3 j)) &&
    (@decide _ (Finset.decidableDforallFinset (s := D.cells4)
      (p := fun j _ => D.old4 j ≤ D.cap4 j)) &&
    @decide _ (Finset.decidableDforallFinset (s := D.cells5)
      (p := fun j _ => D.old5 j ≤ D.cap5 j)))

theorem levelCheck_sound (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (h : D.levelCheck = true) :
    (∀ j ∈ D.cells3, D.old ≤ D.cap3 j) ∧
      (∀ j ∈ D.cells4, D.old4 j ≤ D.cap4 j) ∧
      (∀ j ∈ D.cells5, D.old5 j ≤ D.cap5 j) := by
  simpa only [levelCheck, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] using h

/-- Existing whole-box checks supply the finite historical comparisons
when each stored new cap is identified with its checked midpoint cap.
The fourth and fifth checks use their actual inherited cell values. -/
theorem levelCheck_of_selectedBoxCapChecks (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData)
    (I3 : (Fin 3 → Fin (D.m + 1)) → Finset (Fin 3))
    (I4 : (Fin 4 → Fin (D.m + 1)) → Finset (Fin 4))
    (I5 : (Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)) → Finset (Fin 5))
    (nu3 : (Fin 3 → Fin (D.m + 1)) → ℚ)
    (nu4 : (Fin 4 → Fin (D.m + 1)) → ℚ)
    (nu5 : (Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1)) → ℚ)
    (h3 : ∀ j ∈ D.cells3,
      D.cap3 j = selectedBoxCap (I3 j) D.old (nu3 j)
        (qLogPrimeMeshLo D.a D.b D.m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi D.a D.b D.m j) ∧
      selectedBoxCapCheck (I3 j) D.old (nu3 j)
        (qLogPrimeMeshLo D.a D.b D.m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi D.a D.b D.m j) = true)
    (h4 : ∀ j ∈ D.cells4,
      D.cap4 j = selectedBoxCap (I4 j) (D.old4 j) (nu4 j)
        (qLogPrimeMeshLo D.a D.b D.m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi D.a D.b D.m j) ∧
      selectedBoxCapCheck (I4 j) (D.old4 j) (nu4 j)
        (qLogPrimeMeshLo D.a D.b D.m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi D.a D.b D.m j) = true)
    (h5 : ∀ j ∈ D.cells5,
      D.cap5 j = selectedBoxCap (I5 j) (D.old5 j) (nu5 j)
        (qLogPrimeMeshLo D.a D.b D.m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi D.a D.b D.m j) ∧
      selectedBoxCapCheck (I5 j) (D.old5 j) (nu5 j)
        (qLogPrimeMeshLo D.a D.b D.m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi D.a D.b D.m j) = true) :
    D.levelCheck = true := by
  simp only [levelCheck, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hcap, hcheck⟩ := h3 j hj
    rw [hcap]
    exact (selectedCapLower_old_le (I3 j) D.old _).trans
      (selectedBoxCap_between (I3 j) D.old (nu3 j) _ _ hcheck).1.le
  · intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hcap, hcheck⟩ := h4 j hj
    rw [hcap]
    exact (selectedCapLower_old_le (I4 j) (D.old4 j) _).trans
      (selectedBoxCap_between (I4 j) (D.old4 j) (nu4 j) _ _ hcheck).1.le
  · intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hcap, hcheck⟩ := h5 j hj
    rw [hcap]
    exact (selectedCapLower_old_le (I5 j) (D.old5 j) _).trans
      (selectedBoxCap_between (I5 j) (D.old5 j) (nu5 j) _ _ hcheck).1.le

def exponent4 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) : ℚ :=
  historicalPrefixLookup D.a D.b D.m D.cells4 D.cap4
    (D.exponent3 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) t)) t

def exponent5 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (t : Fin 5 → ℝ) : ℚ :=
  historicalPrefixLookup D.a D.b D.m D.cells5 D.cap5
    (D.exponent4 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) t)) t

theorem exponent4_on_cell (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) (j : Fin 4 → Fin (D.m + 1))
    (ht : t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j) :
    D.exponent4 t = D.cell4 j := by
  change historicalPrefixLookup D.a D.b D.m D.cells4 D.cap4
      (D.exponent3 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) t)) t =
    if j ∈ D.cells4 then D.cap4 j else
      D.cell3 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) j)
  rw [historicalPrefixLookup_on_any_cell D.a D.b hab D.m D.cells4 D.cap4 _ t j ht]
  rw [D.exponent3_on_cell hab _ _
    (mem_logPrimeMeshCell_historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) ht)]

theorem exponent5_on_cell (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (t : Fin 5 → ℝ) (j : Fin 5 → Fin (D.m + 1))
    (ht : t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j) :
    D.exponent5 t = D.cell5 j := by
  change historicalPrefixLookup D.a D.b D.m D.cells5 D.cap5
      (D.exponent4 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) t)) t =
    if j ∈ D.cells5 then D.cap5 j else
      D.cell4 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) j)
  rw [historicalPrefixLookup_on_any_cell D.a D.b hab D.m D.cells5 D.cap5 _ t j ht]
  rw [D.exponent4_on_cell hab _ _
    (mem_logPrimeMeshCell_historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) ht)]

theorem exponent3_outside (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ht : ∀ j ∈ D.cells3,
      t ∉ logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j) :
    D.exponent3 t = D.old :=
  historicalPrefixLookup_outside D.a D.b D.m D.cells3 D.cap3 D.old t ht

theorem exponent4_outside (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (ht : ∀ j ∈ D.cells4,
      t ∉ logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j) :
    D.exponent4 t = D.exponent3 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) t) :=
  historicalPrefixLookup_outside D.a D.b D.m D.cells4 D.cap4 _ t ht

theorem exponent5_outside (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (t : Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (ht : ∀ j ∈ D.cells5,
      t ∉ logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j) :
    D.exponent5 t = D.exponent4 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) t) :=
  historicalPrefixLookup_outside D.a D.b D.m D.cells5 D.cap5 _ t ht

/-- The old cap is constant on the same fourth cell as its replacement,
because its third ancestor has exactly the projected owner. -/
theorem exponent4_apply_sub (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) (f : ℚ → ℝ) :
    f (D.exponent4 t) -
        f (D.exponent3 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) t)) =
      ∑ j ∈ D.cells4,
        if t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j then
          f (D.cap4 j) - f (D.old4 j) else 0 := by
  rw [exponent4, historicalPrefixLookup_apply_sub D.a D.b hab]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  by_cases ht : t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j
  · have hinherit :
        D.exponent3 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) t) = D.old4 j :=
      D.exponent3_on_cell hab _ _
        (mem_logPrimeMeshCell_historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) ht)
    simp only [if_pos ht, hinherit]
  · simp only [if_neg ht]

/-- Both functions of the old and new fifth caps are evaluated on one
joint cell.  This includes every old-rejected candidate. -/
theorem exponent5_apply_sub (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (t : Fin 5 → ℝ) (f : ℚ → ℝ) :
    f (D.exponent5 t) -
        f (D.exponent4 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) t)) =
      ∑ j ∈ D.cells5,
        if t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j then
          f (D.cap5 j) - f (D.old5 j) else 0 := by
  rw [exponent5, historicalPrefixLookup_apply_sub D.a D.b hab]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _hj
  by_cases ht : t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j
  · have hinherit :
        D.exponent4 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) t) = D.old5 j :=
      D.exponent4_on_cell hab _ _
        (mem_logPrimeMeshCell_historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) ht)
    simp only [if_pos ht, hinherit]
  · simp only [if_neg ht]

theorem old_le_exponent3 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true)
    (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) : D.old ≤ D.exponent3 t := by
  exact historicalPrefixLookup_ge_fallback D.a D.b D.m D.cells3
    (fun _ => D.old) D.cap3 D.old t (D.levelCheck_sound hcheck).1 (by intros; rfl)

theorem exponent3_le_exponent4 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true) (t : Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    D.exponent3 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) t) ≤ D.exponent4 t := by
  apply historicalPrefixLookup_ge_fallback D.a D.b D.m D.cells4 D.old4 D.cap4
    _ t (D.levelCheck_sound hcheck).2.1
  intro j _hj ht
  exact D.exponent3_on_cell hab _ _
    (mem_logPrimeMeshCell_historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) ht)

theorem exponent4_le_exponent5 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true) (t : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    D.exponent4 (historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) t) ≤ D.exponent5 t := by
  apply historicalPrefixLookup_ge_fallback D.a D.b D.m D.cells5 D.old5 D.cap5
    _ t (D.levelCheck_sound hcheck).2.2
  intro j _hj ht
  exact D.exponent4_on_cell hab _ _
    (mem_logPrimeMeshCell_historicalPrefixProject (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) ht)

def level4 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ) (history : List ℕ) : ℝ :=
  N ^ (D.exponent4 (primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 4 history) : ℝ)

def level5 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ) (history : List ℕ) : ℝ :=
  N ^ (D.exponent5 (primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 5 history) : ℝ)

theorem level3_outside (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ) (history : List ℕ)
    (hout : ∀ j ∈ D.cells3, primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 3 history ∉
      logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j) :
    D.level3 N history = N ^ (D.old : ℝ) := by
  unfold level3
  rw [D.exponent3_outside _ hout]

/-- Outside adopted fourth cells the old level is the selected third
ancestor's level, rather than the original global constant. -/
theorem level4_outside (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ)
    (history : List ℕ) (hlen : history.length = 4)
    (hout : ∀ j ∈ D.cells4, primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 4 history ∉
      logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j) :
    D.level4 N history = D.level3 N (rosserAncestor 3 history) := by
  unfold level4 level3
  rw [D.exponent4_outside _ hout,
    primeHistoryLogCoordinates_eq_historicalPrefixProject N (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) hlen]

/-- The fifth fallback keeps the complete fourth history, including the
third selection inherited by that fourth history. -/
theorem level5_outside (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ)
    (history : List ℕ) (hlen : history.length = 5)
    (hout : ∀ j ∈ D.cells5, primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 5 history ∉
      logPrimeMeshCell (D.a : ℝ) (D.b : ℝ) D.m j) :
    D.level5 N history = D.level4 N (rosserAncestor 4 history) := by
  unfold level5 level4
  rw [D.exponent5_outside _ hout,
    primeHistoryLogCoordinates_eq_historicalPrefixProject N (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) hlen]

theorem level3_ancestor_le_level4 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true) (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N)
    (history : List ℕ) (hlen : history.length = 4) :
    D.level3 N (rosserAncestor 3 history) ≤ D.level4 N history := by
  unfold level3 level4
  rw [primeHistoryLogCoordinates_eq_historicalPrefixProject N (by omega : 3 ≤ 4) hlen]
  apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hN.le
  exact_mod_cast D.exponent3_le_exponent4 hab hcheck (primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 4 history)

theorem level4_ancestor_le_level5 (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true) (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N)
    (history : List ℕ) (hlen : history.length = 5) :
    D.level4 N (rosserAncestor 4 history) ≤ D.level5 N history := by
  unfold level4 level5
  rw [primeHistoryLogCoordinates_eq_historicalPrefixProject N (by omega : 4 ≤ 5) hlen]
  apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hN.le
  exact_mod_cast D.exponent4_le_exponent5 hab hcheck (primeHistoryLogCoordinates N 5 history)

def upperFourthPolicy (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ) : Bool → List ℕ → Bool :=
  fourthCappedUpperPolicy (ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false (N ^ (D.old : ℝ)))
    (D.level3 N) (D.level4 N)

def upperFifthPolicy (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ) : Bool → List ℕ → Bool :=
  fifthCappedUpperPolicy (ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false (N ^ (D.old : ℝ)))
    (D.level3 N) (D.level5 N)

/-- The concrete historical updates retain the inactive upper parity.
This structural fact supplies the odd-first-exit attachment interface; it
does not imply a support exponent or a factorization license. -/
theorem upperThirdPolicy_even (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ) (pre : List ℕ) :
    D.upperThirdPolicy N true pre = true := by
  simp [upperThirdPolicy, thirdCappedUpperPolicy, firstExitDepthSplicePolicy,
    frozenParityRosserPolicy, ancestorFrozenPolicy]

theorem upperFourthPolicy_even (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ) (pre : List ℕ) :
    D.upperFourthPolicy N true pre = true := by
  simp [upperFourthPolicy, fourthCappedUpperPolicy, thirdCappedUpperPolicy,
    firstExitDepthSplicePolicy, frozenParityRosserPolicy, ancestorFrozenPolicy]

theorem upperFifthPolicy_even (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ) (pre : List ℕ) :
    D.upperFifthPolicy N true pre = true := by
  simp [upperFifthPolicy, fifthCappedUpperPolicy, thirdCappedUpperPolicy,
    firstExitDepthSplicePolicy, frozenParityRosserPolicy, ancestorFrozenPolicy]

theorem upperFifthPolicy_eq_oddFirstExitPolicy (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (N : ℝ) :
    D.upperFifthPolicy N = oddFirstExitPolicy (fun pre => D.upperFifthPolicy N false pre) := by
  funext positive pre
  cases positive <;> simp [oddFirstExitPolicy, upperFifthPolicy_even]

/-- The original historical finite identity now receives its two level
comparisons from a finite rational check.  No prefix-admissibility or
own-cube-admission hypothesis is supplied by the caller. -/
theorem actual_thirdToFifthSaving_eq (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true) (base : Bool → List ℕ → Bool)
    (N cap : ℕ) (hN : 1 < (N : ℝ)) (z : ℝ) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (thirdCappedUpperPolicy base (D.level3 (N : ℝ)))
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) -
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial
        (fifthCappedUpperPolicy base (D.level3 (N : ℝ)) (D.level5 (N : ℝ)))
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) =
      actualHistoricalFourthSaving base (D.level3 (N : ℝ)) (D.level4 (N : ℝ)) N cap z +
        actualHistoricalFifthSaving base (D.level3 (N : ℝ))
          (D.level4 (N : ℝ)) (D.level5 (N : ℝ)) N cap z := by
  apply actualHistoricalThirdToFifthSaving_eq
  · intro state hstate
    apply D.level3_ancestor_le_level4 hab hcheck (N : ℝ) hN
    exact firstExitDepthFrontier_selected_length 4 _ _ [] _ true 1 (by simp) state hstate
  · intro frontier hfrontier candidate hcandidate
    have hlen := firstExitDepthFrontier_selected_length 4
      (thirdCappedUpperPolicy base (D.level3 (N : ℝ)))
      (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z)
      true 1 (by simp) frontier hfrontier
    obtain ⟨_before, q, _after, _hremaining, rfl⟩ :=
      (mem_firstExitNextSelectionCandidates_iff _ _ _ _ _ candidate).mp hcandidate
    have hnext : (q :: frontier.selectedPrefix).length = 5 := by
      simp only [List.length_cons, hlen]
    have h := D.level4_ancestor_le_level5 hab hcheck (N : ℝ) hN
      (q :: frontier.selectedPrefix) hnext
    rw [rosserAncestor_cons 4 q frontier.selectedPrefix (by omega),
      rosserAncestor_self_of_length 4 frontier.selectedPrefix hlen] at h
    exact h

/-- Actual reciprocal-prime densities of the concrete ordinary-base
historical policies telescope with the two inherited savings. -/
theorem upperThirdToFifthSaving_eq (D : HistoricalPrefixCapData) (hab : D.a ≤ D.b)
    (hcheck : D.levelCheck = true) (N cap : ℕ) (hN : 1 < (N : ℝ)) (z : ℝ) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (D.upperThirdPolicy (N : ℝ))
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) -
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial (D.upperFifthPolicy (N : ℝ))
        (fun p : ℕ => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) [] true 1 (roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z) =
      actualHistoricalFourthSaving
          (ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ (D.old : ℝ)))
          (D.level3 (N : ℝ)) (D.level4 (N : ℝ)) N cap z +
        actualHistoricalFifthSaving
          (ordinaryParityRosserPolicy false ((N : ℝ) ^ (D.old : ℝ)))

import ImbalancedChen.PrimeHistoryLogCoordinates
import ImbalancedChen.FrozenRosserPolicy
import ImbalancedChen.RosserShortPrefixAdmissibility

/-!
# A finite box selector on actual prime histories

The adopted cells are explicit finite data. Their half-open ownership
makes the cap constant on each adopted cell, and the old cap is used
outside their union. The selector never tests membership in an arbitrary
compact set. It reads the actual reversed prime history through logarithmic
coordinates and freezes that decision at the selected ancestor.

Whole-cell checks imply the literal integer square gates and a level at
least the old level. No density monotonicity, certificate coverage or
signed distribution theorem is asserted here.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open scoped Classical BigOperators
open VariableEnvelope

/-- Finite cell lookup written as a sum. Uniqueness of half-open cell
ownership leaves exactly one increment on an adopted cell, and zero
increments outside the union. -/
def selectedPrefixMeshCap {d : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin d)) (old nu a b : ℚ)
    (m : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1))) (t : Fin d → ℝ) : ℚ :=
  old + ∑ j ∈ J, if t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j then
    selectedBoxCap I old nu (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) - old
  else 0

theorem selectedPrefixMeshCap_on_cell {d : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin d))
    (old nu a b : ℚ) (hab : a ≤ b) (m : ℕ)
    (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1))) (t : Fin d → ℝ)
    (j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)) (hj : j ∈ J)
    (ht : t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j) :
    selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J t =
      selectedBoxCap I old nu (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) := by
  have habR : (a : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hab
  unfold selectedPrefixMeshCap
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem j hj]
  · rw [if_pos ht]
    ring
  · intro k _hk hkj
    apply if_neg
    intro htk
    exact hkj (logPrimeMeshCell_unique habR htk ht)

theorem selectedPrefixMeshCap_outside {d : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin d))
    (old nu a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (t : Fin d → ℝ)
    (ht : ∀ j ∈ J, t ∉ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j) :
    selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J t = old := by
  unfold selectedPrefixMeshCap
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j hj => if_neg (ht j hj)), add_zero]

/-- The old cap is a global lower bound, including outside the selected
region. The successful stored checks, not an assumed property of the
lookup function, supply this fact. -/
theorem selectedPrefixMeshCap_ge_old {d : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin d))
    (old nu a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (hchecks : ∀ j ∈ J, selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu
      (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) = true)
    (t : Fin d → ℝ) : old ≤ selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J t := by
  unfold selectedPrefixMeshCap
  apply le_add_of_nonneg_right
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j hj
  split_ifs
  · apply sub_nonneg.mpr
    exact (selectedCapLower_old_le I old _).trans
      (selectedBoxCap_between I old nu _ _ (hchecks j hj)).1.le
  · exact le_rfl

/-- Every strict exponent license holds throughout each adopted cell for
the actual finite lookup, with no extra membership filter. -/
theorem selectedPrefixMeshCap_on_cell_sound {d : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin d))
    (old nu a b : ℚ) (hab : a ≤ b) (m : ℕ)
    (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (hchecks : ∀ j ∈ J, selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu
      (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) = true)
    (t : Fin d → ℝ) (j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)) (hj : j ∈ J)
    (ht : t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j) :
    (old : ℝ) < selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J t ∧
      (selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J t : ℝ) < nu ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) < selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J t ∧
      (∀ i, prefixSquareExpr t i < selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J t) ∧
      (∀ i ∉ I, selectedSquareExpr I t i < selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J t) ∧
      (selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J t : ℝ) < v (∑ i ∈ I, t i) := by
  rw [selectedPrefixMeshCap_on_cell I old nu a b hab m J t j hj ht]
  apply selectedBoxCapCheck_sound I old nu _ _ (hchecks j hj) t
  · intro i
    rw [congrFun (cast_qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) i]
    exact (mem_logPrimeMeshCell.mp ht i).1
  · intro i
    rw [congrFun (cast_qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) i]
    exact (mem_logPrimeMeshCell.mp ht i).2.le

/-- One fixed finite adopted family covers the entire licensed compact
set. Its actual lookup strictly raises the old cap at every point of that
set. The mesh and family are chosen before any target or prime history. -/
theorem exists_selectedPrefixMeshCap_cover {d : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin d))
    (old nu a b : ℚ) (hab : a ≤ b) (S : Set (Fin d → ℝ))
    (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hbox : S ⊆ logPrimeBox (fun _ => (a : ℝ)) (fun _ => (b : ℝ)))
    (hlicense : ∀ t ∈ S, SelectedPrefixLicense I old nu t) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1))),
      (∀ j ∈ J, selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu
        (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) = true) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ S, ∃! j, j ∈ J ∧ t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ S, old < selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J t) := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_selectedPrefixMeetingCells_check_threshold
    I old nu a b hab S hS hlicense
  let J := selectedPrefixMeetingCells a b m S
  have hc : ∀ j ∈ J, selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu
      (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) = true := hm m le_rfl
  refine ⟨m, J, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    exact selectedPrefixMeetingCells_unique_cover a b hab m S hbox ht
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨j, hj, _⟩ := selectedPrefixMeetingCells_unique_cover a b hab m S hbox ht
    have hs := selectedPrefixMeshCap_on_cell_sound I old nu a b hab m J hc t j hj.1 hj.2
    exact_mod_cast hs.1

/-- A literal level selected from the logarithms of the actual history.
It depends on the target and selected primes, not on the receiver whose
divisibility polynomial is later evaluated. -/
def actualSelectedPrefixLevel {d : ℕ} (N : ℝ) (I : Finset (Fin d))
    (old nu a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (history : List ℕ) : ℝ :=
  N ^ (selectedPrefixMeshCap I old nu a b m J
    (primeHistoryLogCoordinates N d history) : ℝ)

theorem actualSelectedPrefixLevel_ge_old {d : ℕ} (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N)
    (I : Finset (Fin d)) (old nu a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (hchecks : ∀ j ∈ J, selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu
      (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) = true)
    (history : List ℕ) :
    N ^ (old : ℝ) ≤ actualSelectedPrefixLevel N I old nu a b m J history := by
  apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hN.le
  exact_mod_cast selectedPrefixMeshCap_ge_old I old nu a b m J hchecks
    (primeHistoryLogCoordinates N d history)

theorem actualSelectedPrefixLevel_gt_one {d : ℕ} (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N)
    (I : Finset (Fin d)) (old nu a b : ℚ) (hold : 0 < old) (m : ℕ)
    (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (hchecks : ∀ j ∈ J, selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu
      (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) = true)
    (history : List ℕ) : 1 < actualSelectedPrefixLevel N I old nu a b m J history := by
  have ho : (0 : ℝ) < old := by exact_mod_cast hold
  have hp : 1 < N ^ (old : ℝ) := by
    simpa using Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hN ho
  exact hp.trans_le (actualSelectedPrefixLevel_ge_old N hN I old nu a b m J hchecks history)

theorem actualSelectedPrefixLevel_outside {d : ℕ} (N : ℝ)
    (I : Finset (Fin d)) (old nu a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1))) (history : List ℕ)
    (ht : ∀ j ∈ J, primeHistoryLogCoordinates N d history ∉
      logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j) :
    actualSelectedPrefixLevel N I old nu a b m J history = N ^ (old : ℝ) := by
  unfold actualSelectedPrefixLevel
  rw [selectedPrefixMeshCap_outside I old nu a b m J _ ht]

/-- Old inherited prefix tests remain valid at this actual selected level;
admissibility at the new level is a conclusion. -/
theorem actualSelectedPrefixLevel_inherited_admissible {d : ℕ}
    (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N) (I : Finset (Fin d)) (old nu a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (hchecks : ∀ j ∈ J, selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu
      (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) = true)
    (lower : Bool) (parent history : List ℕ)
    (hparent : ordinaryRosserPrefixAdmissible lower (N ^ (old : ℝ)) parent) :
    ordinaryRosserPrefixAdmissible lower
      (actualSelectedPrefixLevel N I old nu a b m J history) parent :=
  ordinaryRosserPrefixAdmissible_mono lower parent
    (actualSelectedPrefixLevel_ge_old N hN I old nu a b m J hchecks history) hparent

/-- The square gates concern the actual natural history entries in
processing order, with the exact preceding and selected subproducts. -/
theorem actualSelectedPrefixLevel_square_gates {d : ℕ}
    (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N) (I : Finset (Fin d)) (old nu a b : ℚ)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (m : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (hchecks : ∀ j ∈ J, selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu
      (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j) (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) = true)
    (history : List ℕ) (hlen : history.length = d)
    (hpos : ∀ p ∈ history, 0 < p)
    (j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)) (hj : j ∈ J)
    (ht : primeHistoryLogCoordinates N d history ∈
      logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m j) :
    (∀ i, ((∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => k < i),
        primeHistoryTuple d history k : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (primeHistoryTuple d history i : ℝ) ^ 2 <
        actualSelectedPrefixLevel N I old nu a b m J history) ∧
    (∀ i ∉ I, ((∏ k ∈ I, primeHistoryTuple d history k : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      ((∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => k < i ∧ k ∉ I),
        primeHistoryTuple d history k : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (primeHistoryTuple d history i : ℝ) ^ 2 <
        actualSelectedPrefixLevel N I old nu a b m J history) := by
  have hs := selectedPrefixMeshCap_on_cell_sound I old nu a b hab m J hchecks
    (primeHistoryLogCoordinates N d history) j hj ht
  have hp : ∀ i, (primeHistoryTuple d history i : ℝ) ≤
      N ^ primeHistoryLogCoordinates N d history i := by
    intro i
    rw [rpow_primeHistoryLogCoordinates N hN hlen hpos i]
  exact ⟨fun i => prefixSquareExpr_actual_gate N hN _ _ hp i (hs.2.2.2.1 i),
    fun i hi => selectedSquareExpr_actual_gate I N hN _ _ hp i (hs.2.2.2.2.1 i hi)⟩

/-- Freeze the concrete cell lookup at the actual selected ancestor. -/
def actualSelectedPrefixFrozenLevel {d : ℕ} (N : ℝ) (I : Finset (Fin d))
    (old nu a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)))
    (history : List ℕ) : ℝ :=
  actualSelectedPrefixLevel N I old nu a b m J (rosserAncestor d history)

theorem actualSelectedPrefixFrozenLevel_append {d : ℕ} (N : ℝ)
    (I : Finset (Fin d)) (old nu a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1))) (later history : List ℕ)
    (hlen : d ≤ history.length) :
    actualSelectedPrefixFrozenLevel N I old nu a b m J (later ++ history) =
      actualSelectedPrefixFrozenLevel N I old nu a b m J history := by
  unfold actualSelectedPrefixFrozenLevel
  rw [rosserAncestor_append d later history hlen]

theorem actualSelectedPrefixFrozenLevel_at_rank {d : ℕ} (N : ℝ)
    (I : Finset (Fin d)) (old nu a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (J : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1))) (history : List ℕ)
    (hlen : history.length = d) :
    actualSelectedPrefixFrozenLevel N I old nu a b m J history =
      actualSelectedPrefixLevel N I old nu a b m J history := by
  unfold actualSelectedPrefixFrozenLevel
  rw [rosserAncestor_self_of_length d history hlen]

import ImbalancedChen.LogPrimeBoxMesh
import ImbalancedChen.SelectedPrefixCompactCaps

/-!
# Rational meshes selecting all cells that meet a licensed compact set

The rational endpoints cast to the existing real half-open mesh exactly.
All cells meeting the compact set form a finite family, with unique Ico
ownership at every point of the set inside the ambient box. A common fine
mesh makes every such cell's rational cap check succeed. No certificate
coverage, mask choice or admissibility of a manuscript policy is assumed.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open Filter Set
open scoped Classical Topology

def qLogPrimeMeshPoint (a b : ℚ) (m i : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  a + (i : ℚ) * ((b - a) / (m + 1 : ℚ))

def qLogPrimeMeshLo {d : ℕ} (a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)) : Fin d → ℚ :=
  fun i => qLogPrimeMeshPoint a b m (j i).val

def qLogPrimeMeshHi {d : ℕ} (a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)) : Fin d → ℚ :=
  fun i => qLogPrimeMeshPoint a b m ((j i).val + 1)

@[simp] theorem cast_qLogPrimeMeshPoint (a b : ℚ) (m i : ℕ) :
    (qLogPrimeMeshPoint a b m i : ℝ) = logPrimeMeshPoint a b m i := by
  simp [qLogPrimeMeshPoint, logPrimeMeshPoint, logPrimeMeshStep]

theorem cast_qLogPrimeMeshLo {d : ℕ} (a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)) :
    (fun i => (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j i : ℝ)) = logPrimeMeshLo a b m j := by
  funext i
  exact cast_qLogPrimeMeshPoint a b m (j i).val

theorem cast_qLogPrimeMeshHi {d : ℕ} (a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)) :
    (fun i => (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j i : ℝ)) = logPrimeMeshHi a b m j := by
  funext i
  exact cast_qLogPrimeMeshPoint a b m ((j i).val + 1)

/-- Both endpoint vectors are within one mesh step of every point of the
cell. The nonnegative radius version of the Pi metric covers dimension zero. -/
theorem logPrimeMesh_endpoints_dist_le_step {d m : ℕ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    {j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)} {t : Fin d → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell a b m j) :
    dist (logPrimeMeshLo a b m j) t ≤ logPrimeMeshStep a b m ∧
      dist (logPrimeMeshHi a b m j) t ≤ logPrimeMeshStep a b m := by
  have hstep : 0 ≤ logPrimeMeshStep a b m :=
    div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab) (by positivity)
  constructor
  · apply (dist_pi_le_iff hstep).mpr
    intro i
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := mem_logPrimeMeshCell.mp ht i
    have he := logPrimeMeshHi_eq_lo_add_step a b m j i
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · apply (dist_pi_le_iff hstep).mpr
    intro i
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := mem_logPrimeMeshCell.mp ht i
    have he := logPrimeMeshHi_eq_lo_add_step a b m j i
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

theorem logPrimeMeshCell_dist_le_step {d m : ℕ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    {j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)} {x t : Fin d → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ logPrimeMeshCell a b m j) (ht : t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell a b m j) :
    dist x t ≤ logPrimeMeshStep a b m := by
  have hstep : 0 ≤ logPrimeMeshStep a b m :=
    div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab) (by positivity)
  apply (dist_pi_le_iff hstep).mpr
  intro i
  obtain ⟨hxl, hxh⟩ := mem_logPrimeMeshCell.mp hx i
  obtain ⟨htl, hth⟩ := mem_logPrimeMeshCell.mp ht i
  have he := logPrimeMeshHi_eq_lo_add_step a b m j i
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

/-- The finite mesh family is selected by actual intersection with `S`. -/
def selectedPrefixMeetingCells {d : ℕ} (a b : ℚ) (m : ℕ)
    (S : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) : Finset (Fin d → Fin (m + 1)) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun j => ∃ t ∈ S, t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell a b m j)

@[simp] theorem mem_selectedPrefixMeetingCells {d m : ℕ} {a b : ℚ}
    {S : Set (Fin d → ℝ)} {j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)} :
    j ∈ selectedPrefixMeetingCells a b m S ↔
      ∃ t ∈ S, t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell a b m j := by
  simp [selectedPrefixMeetingCells]

/-- Every point of the set has exactly one selected cell, at every mesh
scale. The ambient upper endpoint remains excluded by the Ico convention. -/
theorem selectedPrefixMeetingCells_unique_cover {d : ℕ} (a b : ℚ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (m : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin d → ℝ))
    (hbox : S ⊆ logPrimeBox (fun _ => (a : ℝ)) (fun _ => (b : ℝ)))
    {t : Fin d → ℝ} (ht : t ∈ S) :
    ∃! j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1),
      j ∈ selectedPrefixMeetingCells a b m S ∧ t ∈ logPrimeMeshCell a b m j := by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m (hbox ht)
  refine ⟨j, ⟨mem_selectedPrefixMeetingCells.mpr ⟨t, ht, hj⟩, hj⟩, ?_⟩
  intro k hk
  exact logPrimeMeshCell_unique (by exact_mod_cast hab) hk.2 hj

theorem selectedPrefixMeetingCells_pairwiseDisjoint {d : ℕ}
    (a b : ℚ) (hab : a ≤ b) (m : ℕ) (S : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) :
    (selectedPrefixMeetingCells a b m S : Set (Fin d → Fin (m + 1))).PairwiseDisjoint
      (logPrimeMeshCell (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ) m) := by
  intro j _ k _ hjk
  exact logPrimeMeshCell_pairwiseDisjoint (by exact_mod_cast hab) m
    (Set.mem_univ j) (Set.mem_univ k) hjk

/-- The selected union contains no point farther than one mesh step from
an actual witness in `S`; intersection alone does not assert cell containment. -/
theorem selectedPrefixMeetingCells_point_near {d m : ℕ} {a b : ℚ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    {S : Set (Fin d → ℝ)} {j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)}
    (hj : j ∈ selectedPrefixMeetingCells a b m S) {x : Fin d → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ logPrimeMeshCell a b m j) :
    ∃ t ∈ S, dist x t ≤ logPrimeMeshStep a b m := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htj⟩ := mem_selectedPrefixMeetingCells.mp hj
  exact ⟨t, ht, logPrimeMeshCell_dist_le_step (by exact_mod_cast hab) hx htj⟩

/-- Endpoint witnesses for each selected cell, using the literal rational
endpoint definitions that the cap checker consumes. -/
theorem selectedPrefixMeetingCells_endpoints_near {d m : ℕ} {a b : ℚ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    {S : Set (Fin d → ℝ)} {j : Fin d → Fin (m + 1)}
    (hj : j ∈ selectedPrefixMeetingCells a b m S) :
    ∃ t ∈ S,
      dist (fun i => (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j i : ℝ)) t ≤ logPrimeMeshStep a b m ∧
      dist (fun i => (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j i : ℝ)) t ≤ logPrimeMeshStep a b m := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htj⟩ := mem_selectedPrefixMeetingCells.mp hj
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  rw [cast_qLogPrimeMeshLo, cast_qLogPrimeMeshHi]
  exact logPrimeMesh_endpoints_dist_le_step (by exact_mod_cast hab) htj

/-- All cells meeting the strictly licensed compact set pass the rational
cap check from one mesh threshold onward. The threshold precedes every
selected cell, and no coverage assumption is needed for this implication. -/
theorem exists_selectedPrefixMeetingCells_check_threshold {d : ℕ}
    (I : Finset (Fin d)) (old nu a b : ℚ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (S : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hlicense : ∀ t ∈ S, SelectedPrefixLicense I old nu t) :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ j ∈ selectedPrefixMeetingCells a b m S,
      selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu (qLogPrimeMeshLo a b m j)
        (qLogPrimeMeshHi a b m j) = true := by
  obtain ⟨delta, hd, hcheck⟩ :=
    exists_selectedBoxCapCheck_uniform_radius I old nu S hS hlicense
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    ((tendsto_logPrimeMeshStep (a : ℝ) (b : ℝ)).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hd))
  refine ⟨m₀, ?_⟩
  intro m hm j hj
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hl, hu⟩ := selectedPrefixMeetingCells_endpoints_near hab hj
  exact hcheck t ht _ _ (hl.trans_lt (hm₀ m hm)) (hu.trans_lt (hm₀ m hm))

end

end ImbalancedChen

import ImbalancedChen.SelectedPrefixBoxCap
import ImbalancedChen.CompactLocalThreshold

/-!
# One refinement radius for a compact set of licensed prefixes

The strict selected-prefix license supplies a local endpoint-pair radius.
A common threshold for reciprocal natural radii follows from compactness
and the triangle inequality. The resulting single radius precedes every
center in the set and every rational endpoint pair. Empty compact sets are
included. This does not import certificate boxes or identify their coverage.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

open Filter Topology

/-- All sufficiently fine reciprocal meshes succeed uniformly over the
compact licensed set. The threshold is independent of the center and of
both rational endpoint functions. -/
theorem exists_selectedBoxCapCheck_uniform_mesh {n : ℕ}
    (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old nu : ℚ) (S : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hlicense : ∀ t ∈ S, SelectedPrefixLicense I old nu t) :
    ∃ m₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ m₀ ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ t ∈ S,
      ∀ l u : Fin n → ℚ,
        dist (fun i => (l i : ℝ)) t < 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ) →
        dist (fun i => (u i : ℝ)) t < 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ) →
        selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu l u = true := by
  apply exists_uniform_threshold_on_compact_of_local_nhds S hS
    (fun m t => ∀ l u : Fin n → ℚ,
      dist (fun i => (l i : ℝ)) t < 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ) →
      dist (fun i => (u i : ℝ)) t < 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ) →
      selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu l u = true)
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨delta, hd, hcheck⟩ :=
    exists_selectedBoxCapCheck_radius_of_strict I old nu t (hlicense t ht)
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (half_pos hd)
  refine ⟨m₀, ?_⟩
  apply Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨delta / 2, half_pos hd, ?_⟩
  intro x hx m hm l u hl hu
  have hden : (m₀ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (m : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hm 1
  have hsmall : 1 / (m + 1 : ℝ) < delta / 2 :=
    (one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) hden).trans_lt hm₀
  apply hcheck l u
  · exact (dist_triangle _ x t).trans_lt (by linarith)
  · exact (dist_triangle _ x t).trans_lt (by linarith)

/-- A single positive radius licenses every sufficiently close rational
endpoint pair around every point of the compact set, including its boundary.
Endpoint ordering is unnecessary for the Boolean check itself. -/
theorem exists_selectedBoxCapCheck_uniform_radius {n : ℕ}
    (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old nu : ℚ) (S : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hlicense : ∀ t ∈ S, SelectedPrefixLicense I old nu t) :
    ∃ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧ ∀ t ∈ S, ∀ l u : Fin n → ℚ,
      dist (fun i => (l i : ℝ)) t < delta →
      dist (fun i => (u i : ℝ)) t < delta →
      selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu l u = true := by
  obtain ⟨m₀, _hm₀, hmesh⟩ :=
    exists_selectedBoxCapCheck_uniform_mesh I old nu S hS hlicense
  exact ⟨1 / (m₀ + 1 : ℝ), by positivity, hmesh m₀ le_rfl⟩

import ImbalancedChen.BufferedFirstCubeGeometry
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.Finset
import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Pseudo.Pi

/-!
# Constant selected-prefix caps licensed on whole rational boxes

The complete square gate and selected-subproduct square gate are the
literal finite sums in the manuscript. Their coefficients are nonnegative,
so upper box endpoints bound every gate. The tent lower interval bound
licenses the selected endpoint. A successful rational gap check constructs
one rational midpoint cap, fixed throughout the entire closed box.
This does not import the numerical box data or assert that an arbitrary
original certificate rectangle already passes the constant-cap check.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

open scoped BigOperators
open VariableEnvelope
open Filter Topology

def prefixSquareExpr {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} [CommSemiring α]
    (t : Fin n → α) (j : Fin n) : α :=
  (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => k < j), t k) + 2 * t j

def selectedSquareExpr {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} [CommSemiring α]
    (I : Finset (Fin n)) (t : Fin n → α) (j : Fin n) : α :=
  (∑ k ∈ I, t k) +
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun k => k < j ∧ k ∉ I), t k) + 2 * t j

def selectedCapLowerSet {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old : ℚ) (u : Fin n → ℚ) :
    Finset ℚ :=
  insert old (insert (1 / 2)
    (Finset.univ.image (prefixSquareExpr u) ∪
      (Finset.univ \ I).image (selectedSquareExpr I u)))

theorem selectedCapLowerSet_nonempty {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n))
    (old : ℚ) (u : Fin n → ℚ) : (selectedCapLowerSet I old u).Nonempty :=
  ⟨old, by simp [selectedCapLowerSet]⟩

def selectedCapLower {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old : ℚ) (u : Fin n → ℚ) : ℚ :=
  (selectedCapLowerSet I old u).max' (selectedCapLowerSet_nonempty I old u)

def selectedCapUpper {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (nu : ℚ) (l u : Fin n → ℚ) : ℚ :=
  min nu (qVLo (∑ k ∈ I, l k) (∑ k ∈ I, u k))

def selectedBoxCap {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old nu : ℚ) (l u : Fin n → ℚ) : ℚ :=
  (selectedCapLower I old u + selectedCapUpper I nu l u) / 2

def selectedBoxCapCheck {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old nu : ℚ)
    (l u : Fin n → ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (selectedCapLower I old u < selectedCapUpper I nu l u)

theorem selectedCapLower_old_le {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old : ℚ) (u : Fin n → ℚ) :
    old ≤ selectedCapLower I old u :=
  Finset.le_max' _ _ (by simp [selectedCapLowerSet])

theorem selectedCapLower_half_le {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old : ℚ) (u : Fin n → ℚ) :
    1 / 2 ≤ selectedCapLower I old u :=
  Finset.le_max' _ _ (by simp [selectedCapLowerSet])

theorem selectedCapLower_prefix_le {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old : ℚ)
    (u : Fin n → ℚ) (j : Fin n) :
    prefixSquareExpr u j ≤ selectedCapLower I old u := by
  apply Finset.le_max'
  simp only [selectedCapLowerSet, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image]
  exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩))

theorem selectedCapLower_selected_le {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old : ℚ)
    (u : Fin n → ℚ) (j : Fin n) (hj : j ∉ I) :
    selectedSquareExpr I u j ≤ selectedCapLower I old u := by
  apply Finset.le_max'
  simp only [selectedCapLowerSet, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image]
  exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨j, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hj⟩, rfl⟩))

theorem selectedBoxCap_between {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old nu : ℚ)
    (l u : Fin n → ℚ) (hc : selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu l u = true) :
    selectedCapLower I old u < selectedBoxCap I old nu l u ∧
      selectedBoxCap I old nu l u < selectedCapUpper I nu l u := by
  have h := of_decide_eq_true hc
  dsimp [selectedBoxCap]
  constructor <;> linarith

theorem prefixSquareExpr_mono {n : ℕ} {t u : Fin n → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ i, t i ≤ u i) (j : Fin n) : prefixSquareExpr t j ≤ prefixSquareExpr u j := by
  exact add_le_add (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => h k)) (by nlinarith [h j])

theorem selectedSquareExpr_mono {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) {t u : Fin n → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ i, t i ≤ u i) (j : Fin n) :
    selectedSquareExpr I t j ≤ selectedSquareExpr I u j := by
  exact add_le_add
    (add_le_add (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => h k)) (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => h k)))
    (by nlinarith [h j])

theorem cast_prefixSquareExpr {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → ℚ) (j : Fin n) :
    ((prefixSquareExpr t j : ℚ) : ℝ) = prefixSquareExpr (fun k => (t k : ℝ)) j := by
  simp [prefixSquareExpr]

theorem cast_selectedSquareExpr {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (t : Fin n → ℚ) (j : Fin n) :
    ((selectedSquareExpr I t j : ℚ) : ℝ) = selectedSquareExpr I (fun k => (t k : ℝ)) j := by
  simp [selectedSquareExpr]

/-- All licensing inequalities hold on the closed box for the same
explicit rational cap. No sampling or corner-value assumption is used. -/
theorem selectedBoxCapCheck_sound {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old nu : ℚ)
    (l u : Fin n → ℚ) (hc : selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu l u = true)
    (t : Fin n → ℝ) (hl : ∀ i, (l i : ℝ) ≤ t i) (hu : ∀ i, t i ≤ (u i : ℝ)) :
    (old : ℝ) < selectedBoxCap I old nu l u ∧
      (selectedBoxCap I old nu l u : ℝ) < nu ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) < selectedBoxCap I old nu l u ∧
      (∀ j, prefixSquareExpr t j < selectedBoxCap I old nu l u) ∧
      (∀ j ∉ I, selectedSquareExpr I t j < selectedBoxCap I old nu l u) ∧
      (selectedBoxCap I old nu l u : ℝ) < v (∑ k ∈ I, t k) := by
  have hb := selectedBoxCap_between I old nu l u hc
  have hlow : (selectedCapLower I old u : ℝ) < selectedBoxCap I old nu l u := by
    exact_mod_cast hb.1
  have hhigh : (selectedBoxCap I old nu l u : ℝ) < selectedCapUpper I nu l u := by
    exact_mod_cast hb.2
  have hold : (old : ℝ) ≤ selectedCapLower I old u := by
    exact_mod_cast selectedCapLower_old_le I old u
  have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ selectedCapLower I old u := by
    have hh := Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ) |>.mpr (selectedCapLower_half_le I old u)
    push_cast at hh
    exact hh
  have htop : (selectedCapUpper I nu l u : ℝ) =
      min (nu : ℝ) (qVLo (∑ k ∈ I, l k) (∑ k ∈ I, u k) : ℝ) := by
    simp [selectedCapUpper]
  rw [htop] at hhigh
  refine ⟨hold.trans_lt hlow, hhigh.trans_le (min_le_left _ _), hhalf.trans_lt hlow,
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    have hj : ((prefixSquareExpr u j : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ selectedCapLower I old u := by
      exact_mod_cast selectedCapLower_prefix_le I old u j
    rw [cast_prefixSquareExpr] at hj
    exact (prefixSquareExpr_mono hu j).trans_lt (hj.trans_lt hlow)
  · intro j hj
    have hg : ((selectedSquareExpr I u j : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ selectedCapLower I old u := by
      exact_mod_cast selectedCapLower_selected_le I old u j hj
    rw [cast_selectedSquareExpr] at hg
    exact (selectedSquareExpr_mono I hu j).trans_lt (hg.trans_lt hlow)
  · have hls : ((∑ k ∈ I, l k : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ ∑ k ∈ I, t k := by
      push_cast
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => hl k)
    have hus : (∑ k ∈ I, t k) ≤ ((∑ k ∈ I, u k : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
      push_cast
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => hu k)
    exact (hhigh.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)).trans_le (qVLo_le_v hls hus)

/-- Any rational level strictly inside all endpoint tests makes the
explicit midpoint check succeed. -/
theorem selectedBoxCapCheck_of_witness {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n))
    (old nu lambda : ℚ) (l u : Fin n → ℚ)
    (ho : old < lambda) (hn : lambda < nu) (hh : 1 / 2 < lambda)
    (hp : ∀ j, prefixSquareExpr u j < lambda)
    (hs : ∀ j ∉ I, selectedSquareExpr I u j < lambda)
    (hv : lambda < qVLo (∑ k ∈ I, l k) (∑ k ∈ I, u k)) :
    selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu l u = true := by
  have hlo : selectedCapLower I old u < lambda := by
    apply (Finset.max'_lt_iff _ _).mpr
    intro a ha
    simp only [selectedCapLowerSet, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union,
      Finset.mem_image] at ha
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl | ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    · exact ho
    · exact hh
    · exact hp j
    · exact hs j (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hj).2
  exact decide_eq_true (hlo.trans (lt_min hn hv))

theorem continuous_prefixSquareExpr {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) :
    Continuous (fun t : Fin n → ℝ => prefixSquareExpr t j) := by
  unfold prefixSquareExpr
  fun_prop

theorem continuous_selectedSquareExpr {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (j : Fin n) :
    Continuous (fun t : Fin n → ℝ => selectedSquareExpr I t j) := by
  unfold selectedSquareExpr
  fun_prop

/-- Strict pointwise license implies a common neighborhood of endpoint
pairs on which the *constant-cap* check succeeds. Thus further box
refinement is justified by an actual existence theorem, not by testing
the original rectangle only at corners. The radius precedes all rational
endpoint pairs; those pairs need not themselves be ordered here. -/
theorem exists_selectedBoxCapCheck_radius {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n))
    (old nu lambda : ℚ) (t : Fin n → ℝ)
    (ho : old < lambda) (hn : lambda < nu) (hh : 1 / 2 < lambda)
    (hp : ∀ j, prefixSquareExpr t j < (lambda : ℝ))
    (hs : ∀ j ∉ I, selectedSquareExpr I t j < (lambda : ℝ))
    (hv : (lambda : ℝ) < v (∑ k ∈ I, t k)) :
    ∃ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧ ∀ l u : Fin n → ℚ,
      dist (fun i => (l i : ℝ)) t < delta →
      dist (fun i => (u i : ℝ)) t < delta →
      selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu l u = true := by
  have hep : ∀ᶠ u : Fin n → ℝ in 𝓝 t,
      ∀ j, prefixSquareExpr u j < (lambda : ℝ) := by
    apply eventually_all.mpr
    intro j
    exact (continuous_prefixSquareExpr j).continuousAt.eventually_lt
      continuousAt_const (hp j)
  have hes : ∀ᶠ u : Fin n → ℝ in 𝓝 t,
      ∀ j ∉ I, selectedSquareExpr I u j < (lambda : ℝ) := by
    apply eventually_all.mpr
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j ∈ I
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ h => (h hj).elim)
    · exact ((continuous_selectedSquareExpr I j).continuousAt.eventually_lt
        continuousAt_const (hs j hj)).mono (fun _ h _ => h)
  rw [v_eq_min] at hv
  have hA : Continuous (fun s : Fin n → ℝ => A (∑ k ∈ I, s k)) := by
    unfold A
    fun_prop
  have hC : Continuous (fun s : Fin n → ℝ => C (∑ k ∈ I, s k)) := by
    unfold C
    fun_prop
  have heA : ∀ᶠ l : Fin n → ℝ in 𝓝 t, (lambda : ℝ) < A (∑ k ∈ I, l k) :=
    continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hA.continuousAt (lt_min_iff.mp hv).1
  have heC : ∀ᶠ u : Fin n → ℝ in 𝓝 t, (lambda : ℝ) < C (∑ k ∈ I, u k) :=
    continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hC.continuousAt (lt_min_iff.mp hv).2
  obtain ⟨dl, hdl, hleft⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp heA
  obtain ⟨du, hdu, hright⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hep.and (hes.and heC))
  refine ⟨min dl du, lt_min hdl hdu, ?_⟩
  intro l u hl hu
  have hlA := hleft (hl.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
  obtain ⟨hpU, hsU, hUC⟩ := hright (hu.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
  apply selectedBoxCapCheck_of_witness I old nu lambda l u ho hn hh
  · intro j
    have h := hpU j
    rw [← cast_prefixSquareExpr] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  · intro j hj
    have h := hsU j hj
    rw [← cast_selectedSquareExpr] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  · have hlow : (lambda : ℝ) <
        (qVLo (∑ k ∈ I, l k) (∑ k ∈ I, u k) : ℝ) := by
      rw [cast_qVLo]
      apply lt_min
      · simpa only [Rat.cast_sum] using hlA
      · simpa only [Rat.cast_sum] using hUC
    exact_mod_cast hlow

/-- The pointwise strict selected-prefix license before a common constant
cap has been chosen. The inherited cap is fixed on the old coarse cell. -/
def SelectedPrefixLicense {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old nu : ℚ)
    (t : Fin n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (old : ℝ) < min (nu : ℝ) (v (∑ k ∈ I, t k)) ∧
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) < min (nu : ℝ) (v (∑ k ∈ I, t k)) ∧
    (∀ j, prefixSquareExpr t j < min (nu : ℝ) (v (∑ k ∈ I, t k))) ∧
    (∀ j ∉ I, selectedSquareExpr I t j < min (nu : ℝ) (v (∑ k ∈ I, t k)))

/-- Rational density and the finite maximum construct the intermediate
level from the strict license itself; no selected level is an input. -/
theorem exists_selectedBoxCapCheck_radius_of_strict {n : ℕ}
    (I : Finset (Fin n)) (old nu : ℚ) (t : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h : SelectedPrefixLicense I old nu t) :
    ∃ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta ∧ ∀ l u : Fin n → ℚ,
      dist (fun i => (l i : ℝ)) t < delta →
      dist (fun i => (u i : ℝ)) t < delta →
      selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu l u = true := by
  classical
  let S : Finset ℝ := insert (old : ℝ) (insert (1 / 2)
    (Finset.univ.image (prefixSquareExpr t) ∪
      (Finset.univ \ I).image (selectedSquareExpr I t)))
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨old, by simp [S]⟩
  have hmax : S.max' hS < min (nu : ℝ) (v (∑ k ∈ I, t k)) := by
    apply (Finset.max'_lt_iff _ _).mpr
    intro a ha
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image] at ha
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl | ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    · exact h.1
    · exact h.2.1
    · exact h.2.2.1 j
    · exact h.2.2.2 j (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hj).2
  obtain ⟨lambda, hlamlo, hlamhi⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hmax
  have hbelow (a : ℝ) (ha : a ∈ S) : a < (lambda : ℝ) :=
    (Finset.le_max' S a ha).trans_lt hlamlo
  apply exists_selectedBoxCapCheck_radius I old nu lambda t
  · exact_mod_cast hbelow old (by simp [S])
  · exact_mod_cast hlamhi.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  · have hh := hbelow (1 / 2) (by simp [S])
    apply (Rat.cast_lt (K := ℝ)).mp
    simpa using hh
  · intro j
    apply hbelow
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image]
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩))
  · intro j hj
    apply hbelow
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image]
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨j, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hj⟩, rfl⟩))
  · exact hlamhi.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)

/-- A finite natural subproduct obeys the corresponding exponent bound. -/
theorem naturalSubproduct_le_rpow_sum {n : ℕ} (N : ℝ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (p : Fin n → ℕ) (t : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, (p i : ℝ) ≤ N ^ t i)
    (J : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ((∏ i ∈ J, p i : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ N ^ (∑ i ∈ J, t i) := by
  rw [Nat.cast_prod, Real.rpow_sum_of_pos hN]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => Nat.cast_nonneg (p i)) (fun i _ => hp i)

theorem prefixSquareExpr_actual_gate {n : ℕ} (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N)
    (p : Fin n → ℕ) (t : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, (p i : ℝ) ≤ N ^ t i)
    (j : Fin n) {lambda : ℝ} (hgate : prefixSquareExpr t j < lambda) :
    ((∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i < j), p i : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (p j : ℝ) ^ 2 < N ^ lambda := by
  have hNpos : 0 < N := zero_lt_one.trans hN
  calc
    _ ≤ N ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i < j), t i) * (N ^ t j) ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul (naturalSubproduct_le_rpow_sum N hNpos p t hp _)
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hp j) 2) (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = N ^ prefixSquareExpr t j := by
      rw [prefixSquareExpr, Real.rpow_add hNpos,
        show 2 * t j = t j * (2 : ℕ) by ring, Real.rpow_mul_natCast hNpos.le]
    _ < N ^ lambda := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hN hgate

theorem selectedSquareExpr_actual_gate {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n))
    (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N) (p : Fin n → ℕ) (t : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, (p i : ℝ) ≤ N ^ t i) (j : Fin n) {lambda : ℝ}
    (hgate : selectedSquareExpr I t j < lambda) :
    ((∏ i ∈ I, p i : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      ((∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i < j ∧ i ∉ I), p i : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (p j : ℝ) ^ 2 < N ^ lambda := by
  have hNpos : 0 < N := zero_lt_one.trans hN
  calc
    _ ≤ N ^ (∑ i ∈ I, t i) *
        N ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i < j ∧ i ∉ I), t i) * (N ^ t j) ^ 2 := by
      apply mul_le_mul
      · exact mul_le_mul (naturalSubproduct_le_rpow_sum N hNpos p t hp I)
          (naturalSubproduct_le_rpow_sum N hNpos p t hp _) (by positivity) (by positivity)
      · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hp j) 2
      · positivity
      · positivity
    _ = N ^ selectedSquareExpr I t j := by
      rw [selectedSquareExpr, Real.rpow_add hNpos, Real.rpow_add hNpos,
        show 2 * t j = t j * (2 : ℕ) by ring, Real.rpow_mul_natCast hNpos.le]
    _ < N ^ lambda := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hN hgate

/-- The constructed cap licenses the actual complete and selected integer
square products everywhere in the box, with their precise subproducts. -/
theorem selectedBoxCapCheck_actual_square_gates {n : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin n))
    (old nu : ℚ) (l u : Fin n → ℚ) (hc : selectedBoxCapCheck I old nu l u = true)
    (t : Fin n → ℝ) (hl : ∀ i, (l i : ℝ) ≤ t i) (hu : ∀ i, t i ≤ (u i : ℝ))
    (N : ℝ) (hN : 1 < N) (p : Fin n → ℕ) (hp : ∀ i, (p i : ℝ) ≤ N ^ t i) :
    (∀ j, ((∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i < j), p i : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (p j : ℝ) ^ 2 < N ^ (selectedBoxCap I old nu l u : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ j ∉ I, ((∏ i ∈ I, p i : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      ((∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i < j ∧ i ∉ I), p i : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (p j : ℝ) ^ 2 < N ^ (selectedBoxCap I old nu l u : ℝ)) := by
  have hg := selectedBoxCapCheck_sound I old nu l u hc t hl hu
  exact ⟨fun j => prefixSquareExpr_actual_gate N hN p t hp j (hg.2.2.2.1 j),

import Mathlib.Topology.Compactness.Compact

/-!
# Compact sets turn local common thresholds into one global threshold

The hypothesis supplies an entire parameter neighborhood with one threshold
at each center. Pointwise eventual statements alone do not meet it. A finite
neighborhood subcover and the maximum of its thresholds prove the result.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

open Filter Topology Set

theorem exists_uniform_threshold_on_compact_of_local
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (P : ℕ → X → Prop)
    (hlocal : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[S] x, ∀ N : ℕ, n ≤ N → P N y) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, 2 ≤ N0 ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N → ∀ x ∈ S, P N x := by
  classical
  choose n hn using fun x : S => hlocal x.val x.property
  let U := fun x : S => {y : X | ∀ N : ℕ, n x ≤ N → P N y}
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hS.elim_nhdsWithin_subcover'
    (fun x hx => U ⟨x, hx⟩) (fun x hx => hn ⟨x, hx⟩)
  refine ⟨max 2 (t.sup n), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro N hN x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht hx)
  exact hxy N ((Finset.le_sup (f := n) hy).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans hN))

/-- Ambient neighborhoods can be restricted before applying the compact
subcover. Boundary points of the parameter set remain included. -/
theorem exists_uniform_threshold_on_compact_of_local_nhds
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (P : ℕ → X → Prop)
    (hlocal : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ N : ℕ, n ≤ N → P N y) :
    ∃ N0 : ℕ, 2 ≤ N0 ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, N0 ≤ N → ∀ x ∈ S, P N x := by
  apply exists_uniform_threshold_on_compact_of_local S hS P
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hlocal x hx
  exact ⟨n, hn.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds⟩

end ImbalancedChen

import ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelopeCertificates
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

/-!
# Buffered coarse caps pay the first Rosser cube

The extended-prefix construction retains first labels below `19/96 - 4e`
and uses `min (299/500 - 2e) (Gamma - 2e)`.  This file proves its strict
first-cube margin for the actual rational and integer box lower bounds.
The one-variable fallback also covers the transition strip across `mu`.
No distribution assertion or third-cube admission is assumed or concluded.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope

noncomputable section

def extendedFirstStop : ℝ := 19 / 96

def extendedDistributionCap : ℝ := 299 / 500

def bufferedCoarseCap (e Gamma : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  min (extendedDistributionCap - 2 * e) (Gamma - 2 * e)

theorem buffered_distribution_margin {e x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ≤ extendedFirstStop - 4 * e) :
    17 / 4000 + 10 * e ≤ extendedDistributionCap - 2 * e - 3 * x := by
  dsimp [extendedFirstStop, extendedDistributionCap] at *
  linarith

theorem extended_v_margin_above_mu {x : ℝ} (hx : mu ≤ x) :
    v x - 3 * x = (9 / 2) * (extendedFirstStop - x) := by
  rw [v_eq_C hx]
  dsimp [C, extendedFirstStop]
  ring

theorem buffered_v_margin {e x : ℝ} (he : 0 < e)
    (hsmall : 3 * e < 3 / 256)
    (hx : x ≤ extendedFirstStop - 4 * e) :
    3 * e < v x - 3 * x := by
  by_cases hm : x ≤ mu
  · rw [v_eq_A hm]
    dsimp [A, mu] at *
    linarith
  · rw [extended_v_margin_above_mu (le_of_not_ge hm)]
    linarith

theorem three_mul_lt_bufferedCoarseCap {e x Gamma : ℝ} (he : 0 < e)
    (hx : x ≤ extendedFirstStop - 4 * e) (hGamma : 3 * x < Gamma - 2 * e) :
    3 * x < bufferedCoarseCap e Gamma := by
  apply lt_min (by linarith [buffered_distribution_margin hx]) hGamma

/-- A whole-box lower bound with error at most `e` retains a strict cube margin. -/
theorem bufferedCoarseCap_original_lower {e x y z Gamma : ℝ}
    (he : 0 < e) (hsmall : 3 * e < 3 / 256)
    (hx : x ≤ extendedFirstStop - 4 * e) (h : Ordered x y z)
    (herr : original x y z - Gamma ≤ e) :
    3 * x < bufferedCoarseCap e Gamma := by
  apply three_mul_lt_bufferedCoarseCap he hx
  linarith [original_margin h]

/-- Unlike the full envelope, this fallback needs no restriction `x ≤ mu`. -/
theorem bufferedCoarseCap_v_lower {e x Gamma : ℝ}
    (he : 0 < e) (hsmall : 3 * e < 3 / 256)
    (hx : x ≤ extendedFirstStop - 4 * e) (herr : v x - Gamma ≤ e) :
    3 * x < bufferedCoarseCap e Gamma := by
  apply three_mul_lt_bufferedCoarseCap he hx
  linarith [buffered_v_margin he hsmall hx]

theorem rationalBox_buffered_first_cube (b : RationalBox) {e x y z : ℝ}
    (he : 0 < e) (hsmall : 3 * e < 3 / 256)
    (h : b.ValidPoint x y z) (hstop : (b.ux : ℝ) ≤ extendedFirstStop - 4 * e)
    (hwidth : (9 / 2 : ℝ) * b.width ≤ e) :
    3 * x < bufferedCoarseCap e b.lower := by
  exact bufferedCoarseCap_original_lower he hsmall (h.1.2.1.trans hstop) h.2
    ((RationalBox.enclosure_error h).2.1.trans hwidth)

/-- The integer certificate retains its separate rounding error `2 / D`. -/
theorem scaledBox_buffered_first_cube (D M : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox)
    (hD : 0 < D) (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) {e x y z : ℝ}
    (he : 0 < e) (hsmall : 3 * e < 3 / 256)
    (h : (b.toRational D).ValidPoint x y z)
    (hstop : ((b.toRational D).ux : ℝ) ≤ extendedFirstStop - 4 * e)
    (hprecision : (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (b.toRational D).width + 2 / D ≤ e) :
    3 * x < bufferedCoarseCap e (b.lower D) := by
  exact bufferedCoarseCap_original_lower he hsmall (h.1.2.1.trans hstop) h.2
    ((ScaledBox.enclosure_error D M b hD hM h).2.1.trans hprecision)

theorem rationalInterval_v_error {l u : ℚ} {x : ℝ}
    (hl : (l : ℝ) ≤ x) (hu : x ≤ (u : ℝ)) :
    v x - qVLo l u ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((u : ℝ) - l) := by
  have hlu : l ≤ u := by exact_mod_cast hl.trans hu
  have hg : (qVHi l u : ℝ) - qVLo l u ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((u : ℝ) - l) := by
    have hh := Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ) |>.mpr (qVHi_sub_qVLo_le hlu)
    push_cast at hh
    exact hh
  linarith [v_le_qVHi hl hu]

/-- A fixed rational interval supplies the fallback cap, including crossing intervals. -/
theorem rationalInterval_buffered_first_cube {l u : ℚ} {e x : ℝ}
    (he : 0 < e) (hsmall : 3 * e < 3 / 256)
    (hl : (l : ℝ) ≤ x) (hu : x ≤ (u : ℝ))
    (hstop : (u : ℝ) ≤ extendedFirstStop - 4 * e)
    (hwidth : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ((u : ℝ) - l) ≤ e) :
    3 * x < bufferedCoarseCap e (qVLo l u) := by
  exact bufferedCoarseCap_v_lower he hsmall (hu.trans hstop)
    ((rationalInterval_v_error hl hu).trans hwidth)

/-- Convert the exponent margin to the literal strict integer-prefix cube test. -/
theorem first_cube_lt_level_of_exponent {N x lambda : ℝ} (p : ℕ)
    (hN : 1 < N) (hp : (p : ℝ) ≤ N ^ x) (hmargin : 3 * x < lambda) :
    (p : ℝ) ^ 3 < N ^ lambda := by
  calc
    (p : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (N ^ x) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hp 3
    _ = N ^ (x * 3) := (Real.rpow_mul_natCast (by linarith) x 3).symm
    _ < N ^ lambda := Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hN (by linarith)

theorem rationalBox_buffered_prime_cube (b : RationalBox) {e x y z N : ℝ}
    (p : ℕ) (hN : 1 < N) (hp : (p : ℝ) ≤ N ^ x)
    (he : 0 < e) (hsmall : 3 * e < 3 / 256)
    (h : b.ValidPoint x y z) (hstop : (b.ux : ℝ) ≤ extendedFirstStop - 4 * e)
    (hwidth : (9 / 2 : ℝ) * b.width ≤ e) :
    (p : ℝ) ^ 3 < N ^ bufferedCoarseCap e b.lower :=
  first_cube_lt_level_of_exponent p hN hp
    (rationalBox_buffered_first_cube b he hsmall h hstop hwidth)

/-- Certificate acceptance bounds the literal clipped cap, not only the envelope. -/
theorem scaled_marginCheck_clipped_cap (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) {eta : ℚ}
    (hc : b.marginCheck D M NT eta = true) {x y z : ℝ}
    (h : (b.toRational D).ValidPoint x y z) :
    3 * x + eta < (b.clippedLower D M NT : ℝ) := by
  have hh : ((0 < D ∧ 128 * M = 25 * D) ∧ (b.toRational D).feasible = true) ∧
      0 < b.clippedLower D M NT - 3 * ((b.ux : ℚ) / D) - eta := by
    simpa only [ScaledBox.marginCheck, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] using hc
  have hcr : (0 : ℝ) < (b.clippedLower D M NT : ℝ) -
      3 * ((b.ux : ℝ) / D) - eta := by exact_mod_cast hh.2
  have hx : x ≤ (b.ux : ℝ) / D := by
    simpa only [ScaledBox.toRational, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast] using h.1.2.1
  linarith

end

end ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope
