import ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelopeBoxes
import ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelopeScaled

/-!
# Whole-box bridge for the existing integer prefix certificates

`rawLower`, `rawUpper`, and `phiRange` preserve the integer formulas of
`certify_variable_prefix.py` and the below-mu branch of
`certify_extended_prefix.py`, including signed rounding and `min(NT, ...)`.
The clipped upper endpoint bounds the clipped envelope only. The explicit
extended adapter requires the script's actual below-mu dispatch condition;
no result about its different above-mu expression is asserted.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope

structure ScaledBox where
  lx : ℤ
  ux : ℤ
  ly : ℤ
  uy : ℤ
  lz : ℤ
  uz : ℤ
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace ScaledBox

def toRational (D : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) : RationalBox :=
  ⟨(b.lx : ℚ) / D, (b.ux : ℚ) / D, (b.ly : ℚ) / D,
    (b.uy : ℚ) / D, (b.lz : ℚ) / D, (b.uz : ℚ) / D⟩

/-- Exact `low` before the certificate's final `min(NT, low)`. -/
def rawLower (D : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) : ℤ :=
  maxSeven (scaledVLo D b.lx b.ux) (scaledVLo D b.ly b.uy)
    (scaledVLo D (b.lx + b.ly) (b.ux + b.uy))
    (scaledVLo D (b.lx + b.ly + b.lz) (b.ux + b.uy + b.uz))
    (scaledVLo D (b.lx + b.lz) (b.ux + b.uz))
    (scaledVLo D (b.ly + b.lz) (b.uy + b.uz)) (scaledBLo D b.uz)

/-- Exact `high` before the certificate's final `min(NT, high)`. -/
def rawUpper (D M : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) : ℤ :=
  maxSeven (scaledVHi D M b.lx b.ux) (scaledVHi D M b.ly b.uy)
    (scaledVHi D M (b.lx + b.ly) (b.ux + b.uy))
    (scaledVHi D M (b.lx + b.ly + b.lz) (b.ux + b.uy + b.uz))
    (scaledVHi D M (b.lx + b.lz) (b.ux + b.uz))
    (scaledVHi D M (b.ly + b.lz) (b.uy + b.uz)) (scaledBHi D b.lz)

/-- Exact pair returned by the old `phi_range`, including its truncation. -/
def phiRange (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) : ℤ × ℤ :=
  (min NT (rawLower D b), min NT (rawUpper D M b))

def lower (D : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) : ℚ := (rawLower D b : ℚ) / D

def upper (D M : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) : ℚ := (rawUpper D M b : ℚ) / D

def clippedLower (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) : ℚ := ((phiRange D M NT b).1 : ℚ) / D

def clippedUpper (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) : ℚ := ((phiRange D M NT b).2 : ℚ) / D

/-- A true result includes positivity, an exact crossing coordinate, and nonemptiness. -/
def marginCheck (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (η : ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (0 < D ∧ 128 * M = 25 * D) &&
    (toRational D b).feasible &&
    decide (0 < clippedLower D M NT b - 3 * ((b.ux : ℚ) / D) - η)

/-- Only the actual below-mu path of the extended certificate is accepted. -/
def extendedBelowCheck (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (η : ℚ) : Bool :=
  decide (b.lx < M ∧ b.ux ≤ M) && marginCheck D M NT b η

private theorem cast_int_maxSeven (a b c d e f g : ℤ) :
    ((maxSeven a b c d e f g : ℤ) : ℝ) = maxSeven (a : ℝ) b c d e f g := by
  simp [maxSeven]

private theorem mul_maxSeven (D a b c d e f g : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D) :
    D * maxSeven a b c d e f g =
      maxSeven (D*a) (D*b) (D*c) (D*d) (D*e) (D*f) (D*g) := by
  simp only [maxSeven, mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ hD]

private theorem maxSeven_add_one (a b c d e f g : ℝ) :
    maxSeven (a+1) (b+1) (c+1) (d+1) (e+1) (f+1) (g+1) =
      maxSeven a b c d e f g + 1 := by
  simp only [maxSeven, max_add_add_right]

/-- The entire old lower algorithm rounds the rational box lower bound down by at most one. -/
theorem rawLower_scaled_rounding (D : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (rawLower D b : ℝ) ≤ D * ((toRational D b).lower : ℝ) ∧
    D * ((toRational D b).lower : ℝ) ≤ (rawLower D b : ℝ) + 1 := by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hD
  have hx := scaledVLo_rounding D b.lx b.ux hD
  have hy := scaledVLo_rounding D b.ly b.uy hD
  have hxy := scaledVLo_rounding D (b.lx+b.ly) (b.ux+b.uy) hD
  have hxyz := scaledVLo_rounding D (b.lx+b.ly+b.lz) (b.ux+b.uy+b.uz) hD
  have hxz := scaledVLo_rounding D (b.lx+b.lz) (b.ux+b.uz) hD
  have hyz := scaledVLo_rounding D (b.ly+b.lz) (b.uy+b.uz) hD
  have hb := scaledBLo_rounding D b.uz hD
  constructor
  · convert maxSeven_mono hx.1 hy.1 hxy.1 hxyz.1 hxz.1 hyz.1 hb.1 using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | simp only [rawLower, RationalBox.lower, toRational, cast_int_maxSeven,
        cast_maxSeven, mul_maxSeven _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hD0, Int.cast_add, add_div]
  · have hh := maxSeven_mono hx.2 hy.2 hxy.2 hxyz.2 hxz.2 hyz.2 hb.2
    rw [maxSeven_add_one] at hh
    convert hh using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | simp only [rawLower, RationalBox.lower, toRational, cast_int_maxSeven,
        cast_maxSeven, mul_maxSeven _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hD0, Int.cast_add, add_div]

/-- The entire old upper algorithm rounds the rational box upper bound up by at most one. -/
theorem rawUpper_scaled_rounding (D M : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) :
    D * ((toRational D b).upper : ℝ) ≤ (rawUpper D M b : ℝ) ∧
    (rawUpper D M b : ℝ) ≤ D * ((toRational D b).upper : ℝ) + 1 := by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hD
  have hx := scaledVHi_rounding D M b.lx b.ux hD hM
  have hy := scaledVHi_rounding D M b.ly b.uy hD hM
  have hxy := scaledVHi_rounding D M (b.lx+b.ly) (b.ux+b.uy) hD hM
  have hxyz := scaledVHi_rounding D M (b.lx+b.ly+b.lz) (b.ux+b.uy+b.uz) hD hM
  have hxz := scaledVHi_rounding D M (b.lx+b.lz) (b.ux+b.uz) hD hM
  have hyz := scaledVHi_rounding D M (b.ly+b.lz) (b.uy+b.uz) hD hM
  have hb := scaledBHi_rounding D b.lz hD
  constructor
  · convert maxSeven_mono hx.1 hy.1 hxy.1 hxyz.1 hxz.1 hyz.1 hb.1 using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | simp only [rawUpper, RationalBox.upper, toRational, cast_int_maxSeven,
        cast_maxSeven, mul_maxSeven _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hD0, Int.cast_add, add_div]
  · have hh := maxSeven_mono hx.2 hy.2 hxy.2 hxyz.2 hxz.2 hyz.2 hb.2
    rw [maxSeven_add_one] at hh
    convert hh using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | simp only [rawUpper, RationalBox.upper, toRational, cast_int_maxSeven,
        cast_maxSeven, mul_maxSeven _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hD0, Int.cast_add, add_div]





/-- After normalization, downward rounding costs at most `1 / D`. -/
theorem rawLower_rounding (D : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D) :
    lower D b ≤ (toRational D b).lower ∧
    (toRational D b).lower ≤ lower D b + 1 / (D : ℚ) := by
  have hDQ : (0 : ℚ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hh : (rawLower D b : ℚ) ≤ D * (toRational D b).lower ∧
      D * (toRational D b).lower ≤ (rawLower D b : ℚ) + 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast rawLower_scaled_rounding D b hD
  unfold lower
  constructor
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hDQ).2
    nlinarith [hh.1]
  · rw [← add_div]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hDQ).2
    nlinarith [hh.2]

/-- After normalization, upward rounding costs at most `1 / D`. -/
theorem rawUpper_rounding (D M : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) :
    (toRational D b).upper ≤ upper D M b ∧
    upper D M b ≤ (toRational D b).upper + 1 / (D : ℚ) := by
  have hDQ : (0 : ℚ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hh : D * (toRational D b).upper ≤ (rawUpper D M b : ℚ) ∧
      (rawUpper D M b : ℚ) ≤ D * (toRational D b).upper + 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast rawUpper_scaled_rounding D M b hD hM
  unfold upper
  constructor
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ hDQ).2
    nlinarith [hh.1]
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hDQ).2
    have hc : (1 : ℚ) / D * D = 1 := div_mul_cancel₀ 1 (ne_of_gt hDQ)
    nlinarith [hh.2]

/-- The raw old-script interval bounds the original eight gated branches at every valid point. -/
theorem raw_bounds (D M : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) {x y z : ℝ}
    (h : (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z) :
    (lower D b : ℝ) ≤ original x y z ∧ original x y z ≤ (upper D M b : ℝ) := by
  have hl : (lower D b : ℝ) ≤ ((toRational D b).lower : ℝ) :=
    Rat.cast_le.mpr (rawLower_rounding D b hD).1
  have hu : ((toRational D b).upper : ℝ) ≤ (upper D M b : ℝ) :=
    Rat.cast_le.mpr (rawUpper_rounding D M b hD hM).1
  exact ⟨hl.trans (RationalBox.lower_le_original h),
    (RationalBox.original_le_upper h).trans hu⟩

theorem clippedLower_eq (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D) :
    clippedLower D M NT b = min ((NT : ℚ) / D) (lower D b) := by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hD
  simp only [clippedLower, phiRange, Int.cast_min, lower, min_div_div_right hD0]

theorem clippedUpper_eq (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D) :
    clippedUpper D M NT b = min ((NT : ℚ) / D) (upper D M b) := by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hD
  simp only [clippedUpper, phiRange, Int.cast_min, upper, min_div_div_right hD0]

/-- `phi_range` bounds the truncated envelope; its upper endpoint need not bound `original`. -/
theorem phiRange_bounds (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) {x y z : ℝ}
    (h : (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z) :
    (clippedLower D M NT b : ℝ) ≤ min ((NT : ℝ) / D) (original x y z) ∧
    min ((NT : ℝ) / D) (original x y z) ≤ (clippedUpper D M NT b : ℝ) := by
  rw [clippedLower_eq D M NT b hD, clippedUpper_eq D M NT b hD]
  simp only [Rat.cast_min, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast]
  have hh := raw_bounds D M b hD hM h
  exact ⟨min_le_min_left _ hh.1, min_le_min_left _ hh.2⟩

/-- The clipped lower endpoint also remains a lower bound for the untruncated envelope. -/
theorem clippedLower_le_original (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) {x y z : ℝ}
    (h : (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z) :
    (clippedLower D M NT b : ℝ) ≤ original x y z :=
  (phiRange_bounds D M NT b hD hM h).1.trans (min_le_right _ _)

/-- Integer precision and geometric width contribute separately to the interval gap. -/
theorem upper_sub_lower_le (D M : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) (hw : (toRational D b).WellFormed) :
    upper D M b - lower D b ≤ 9 / 2 * (toRational D b).width + 2 / (D : ℚ) := by
  have hl := rawLower_rounding D b hD
  have hu := rawUpper_rounding D M b hD hM
  have hg := RationalBox.upper_sub_lower_le hw
  have htwo : (2 : ℚ) / D = 2 * (1 / (D : ℚ)) := by ring
  rw [htwo]
  linarith [hl.2, hu.2]

private theorem min_gap {a b t δ : ℚ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (h : b - a ≤ δ) :
    min t b - min t a ≤ δ := by
  by_cases ha : a ≤ t
  · rw [min_eq_right ha]
    linarith [min_le_right t b]
  · rw [min_eq_left (le_of_not_ge ha)]
    linarith [min_le_left t b]

/-- Truncation does not enlarge the explicit width-plus-rounding error bound. -/
theorem clippedUpper_sub_clippedLower_le (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) (hw : (toRational D b).WellFormed) :
    clippedUpper D M NT b - clippedLower D M NT b ≤
      9 / 2 * (toRational D b).width + 2 / (D : ℚ) := by
  rw [clippedLower_eq D M NT b hD, clippedUpper_eq D M NT b hD]
  have hDQ : (0 : ℚ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
  apply min_gap _ (upper_sub_lower_le D M b hD hM hw)
  have hwidth := RationalBox.width_nonneg (toRational D b)
  have hround : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 2 / D := div_nonneg (by norm_num) (le_of_lt hDQ)
  linarith

/-- Both one-sided errors obey the same explicit bound, with no extremum-sampling assumption. -/
theorem enclosure_error (D M : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) {x y z : ℝ}
    (h : (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z) :
    0 ≤ original x y z - lower D b ∧
    original x y z - lower D b ≤ (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (toRational D b).width + 2 / D ∧
    0 ≤ (upper D M b : ℝ) - original x y z ∧
    (upper D M b : ℝ) - original x y z ≤ (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (toRational D b).width + 2 / D := by
  have hh := raw_bounds D M b hD hM h
  have hg : (upper D M b : ℝ) - lower D b ≤
      (9 / 2 : ℝ) * (toRational D b).width + 2 / D := by
    have hh := Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ) |>.mpr
      (upper_sub_lower_le D M b hD hM (RationalBox.wellFormed_of_inBox h.1))
    push_cast at hh
    exact hh
  constructor
  · linarith [hh.1]
  constructor
  · linarith [hh.1, hh.2]
  constructor <;> linarith [hh.1, hh.2]

/-- Width tending to zero and growing scale give an explicit error target.
At a fixed integer scale the separate `2 / D` term is deliberately retained. -/
theorem error_lt_of_width_and_precision (D M : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) {x y z ε : ℝ}
    (h : (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z)
    (hw : ((toRational D b).width : ℝ) < ε / 9)
    (hp : (2 : ℝ) / D ≤ ε / 2) :
    original x y z - lower D b < ε ∧ (upper D M b : ℝ) - original x y z < ε := by
  have hh := enclosure_error D M b hD hM h
  constructor <;> linarith [hh.2.1, hh.2.2.2]

/-- Rational success certifies the strict surplus at every actual point of the effective box. -/
theorem margin_of_rational_check (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) {η : ℚ}
    (hc : 0 < clippedLower D M NT b - 3 * ((b.ux : ℚ) / D) - η)
    {x y z : ℝ} (h : (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z) :
    0 < original x y z - 3 * x - η := by
  have hcr : (0 : ℝ) < (clippedLower D M NT b : ℝ) - 3 * ((b.ux : ℝ) / D) - η := by
    exact_mod_cast hc
  have hl := clippedLower_le_original D M NT b hD hM h
  have hx : x ≤ (b.ux : ℝ) / D := by
    simpa only [toRational, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast] using h.1.2.1
  linarith

/-- Acceptance proves nonemptiness and a strict surplus, using only integer/rational checks. -/
theorem marginCheck_sound (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) {η : ℚ}
    (h : marginCheck D M NT b η = true) :
    (∃ x y z : ℝ, (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z) ∧
      ∀ x y z : ℝ, (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z →
        0 < original x y z - 3 * x - η := by
  have hh : ((0 < D ∧ 128 * M = 25 * D) ∧ (toRational D b).feasible = true) ∧
      0 < clippedLower D M NT b - 3 * ((b.ux : ℚ) / D) - η := by
    simpa only [marginCheck, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] using h
  exact ⟨(RationalBox.feasible_iff _).mp hh.1.2,
    fun _ _ _ hp => margin_of_rational_check D M NT b hh.1.1.1 hh.1.1.2 hh.2 hp⟩

/-- An empty effective box can never receive a successful surplus certificate. -/
theorem marginCheck_false_of_empty (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) (η : ℚ)
    (he : ¬ ∃ x y z : ℝ, (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z) :
    marginCheck D M NT b η = false := by
  cases hc : marginCheck D M NT b η
  · rfl
  · exact False.elim (he (marginCheck_sound D M NT b hc).1)

/-- The extended adapter exposes and proves its precise below-mu dispatch restriction. -/
theorem extendedBelowCheck_sound (D M NT : ℤ) (b : ScaledBox) {η : ℚ}
    (h : extendedBelowCheck D M NT b η = true) :
    (b.lx < M ∧ b.ux ≤ M) ∧
    (∃ x y z : ℝ, (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z) ∧
      ∀ x y z : ℝ, (toRational D b).ValidPoint x y z →
        0 < original x y z - 3 * x - η := by
  have hh : (b.lx < M ∧ b.ux ≤ M) ∧ marginCheck D M NT b η = true := by
    simpa only [extendedBelowCheck, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] using h
  exact ⟨hh.1, marginCheck_sound D M NT b hh.2⟩

end ScaledBox

import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Ring.Real
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.Lattice
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# The literal eight-branch variable envelope

At residue exponent `alpha = 1` and spectral exponent `7/32`, this file
retains all eight branches and every gate in the manuscript's definition.
It proves the six-branch identity on `0 ≤ z ≤ y ≤ x ≤ 25/128`, including
the boundary `z = 0`. This is an algebraic result, not a distribution or
sieve estimate, and makes no claim for perturbed residue exponents.

Reference: manuscript section "A continuous six-branch expression on the
ordered domain", `variable-envelope-simplification.tex`; the starting
functions specialize Lichtman, arXiv:2309.08522v1, (6.2) and (6.4).
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope

noncomputable section

/-- The crossing point of the two active affine branches. -/
def mu : ℝ := 25 / 128

/-- The global upper bound for the simplified level. -/
def cap : ℝ := 153 / 256

def A (t : ℝ) : ℝ := (1 + t) / 2
def C (t : ℝ) : ℝ := 57 / 64 - 3 / 2 * t
def B (t : ℝ) : ℝ := cap - 3 / 8 * t

/-- The original three-way minimum, before removing its middle branch. -/
def v (t : ℝ) : ℝ := min (A t) (min ((32 - 34 * t) / 39) (C t))

/-- The original gate: retain the value at equality, and return zero on failure. -/
def psi (a b : ℝ) : ℝ := if b ≤ a then a else 0

/-- The inner minimum in the original `w` branch. -/
def wInner (_a b c : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  min ((66 - 34 * c) / 107) (min (B c) (1 - 2 * b))

/-- The original gated `w` branch. -/
def w (a b c : ℝ) : ℝ := psi (wInner a b c) (A a)

/-- All eight original branches, with both `w` and both pair gates intact. -/
def original (x y z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  max (v x) (max (v y) (max (v (x + y)) (max (v (x + y + z))
    (max (w x y z) (max (w x z y)
      (max (psi (v (x + z)) (x + 2 * y + z))
        (psi (v (y + z)) (2 * x + y + z))))))))

/-- The six continuous branches, asserted equal to `original` only on the ordered domain. -/
def six (x y z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  max (v x) (max (v (x + y)) (max (v (x + y + z))
    (max (B z) (max (v (x + z)) (v (y + z))))))

/-- The closed ordered domain; the manuscript additionally assumes `0 < z`. -/
def Ordered (x y z : ℝ) : Prop := 0 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ y ∧ y ≤ x ∧ x ≤ mu

/-- The middle affine branch is redundant (even for negative inputs). -/
theorem v_eq_min (t : ℝ) : v t = min (A t) (C t) := by
  have h : min (A t) (C t) ≤ (32 - 34 * t) / 39 := by
    by_cases ht : t ≤ mu
    · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (by dsimp [A, mu] at *; linarith)
    · exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (by dsimp [C, mu] at *; linarith)
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_min (min_le_left _ _) ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
  · exact le_min (min_le_left _ _) (le_min h (min_le_right _ _))

theorem v_eq_A {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ mu) : v t = A t := by
  rw [v_eq_min, min_eq_left]
  dsimp [A, C, mu] at *
  linarith

theorem v_eq_C {t : ℝ} (ht : mu ≤ t) : v t = C t := by
  rw [v_eq_min, min_eq_right]
  dsimp [A, C, mu] at *
  linarith

theorem v_le_cap (t : ℝ) : v t ≤ cap := by
  by_cases ht : t ≤ mu
  · rw [v_eq_A ht]
    dsimp [A, mu, cap] at *
    linarith
  · rw [v_eq_C (le_of_not_ge ht)]
    dsimp [C, mu, cap] at *
    linarith

/-- Both original inner minima reduce to `B` on the required coordinate ranges. -/
theorem wInner_eq_B (a : ℝ) {b c : ℝ} (hb : b ≤ mu) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    wInner a b c = B c := by
  have h₁ : B c ≤ (66 - 34 * c) / 107 := by
    dsimp [B, cap]; linarith
  have h₂ : B c ≤ 1 - 2 * b := by
    dsimp [B, cap, mu] at *; linarith
  simp only [wInner, min_eq_left h₂, min_eq_right h₁]

/-- A nonnegative baseline absorbs a failed gate. -/
theorem max_psi_eq {b a t : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hgate : b ≤ a → t ≤ a) :
    max b (psi a t) = max b a := by
  by_cases ht : t ≤ a
  · simp [psi, ht]
  · have hab : a ≤ b := le_of_not_ge (fun h => ht (hgate h))
    simp [psi, ht, max_eq_left hb, max_eq_left hab]

/-- A winning pair branch has a strictly positive uniform gate surplus.
The generalized statement makes both original pair gates immediate instances. -/
theorem pair_gate_margin {x s r : ℝ} (hx : x ≤ mu) (hr : r ≤ x)
    (hwin : v x ≤ v s) : 3 / 256 ≤ v s - (s + 2 * r) := by
  rw [v_eq_A hx] at hwin
  have hs : A x ≤ C s := hwin.trans (by rw [v_eq_min]; exact min_le_right _ _)
  rw [v_eq_min]
  have hA : s + 2 * r + 3 / 256 ≤ A s := by
    dsimp [A, C, mu] at *; linarith
  have hC : s + 2 * r + 3 / 256 ≤ C s := by
    dsimp [A, C, mu] at *; linarith
  linarith [le_min hA hC]

theorem xz_gate_margin {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z)
    (hwin : v x ≤ v (x + z)) :
    3 / 256 ≤ v (x + z) - (x + 2 * y + z) := by
  have hm := pair_gate_margin h.2.2.2 h.2.2.1 hwin
  linarith

theorem yz_gate_margin {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z)
    (hwin : v x ≤ v (y + z)) :
    3 / 256 ≤ v (y + z) - (2 * x + y + z) := by
  have hm := pair_gate_margin h.2.2.2 (le_refl x) hwin
  linarith

private theorem max_base_max (b a c : ℝ) :
    max b (max a c) = max (max b a) (max b c) := by
  apply le_antisymm <;> simp only [max_le_iff] <;> simp

/-- The original eight branches equal the six ungated branches on the ordered domain.
No branch equality, continuity, or analytic estimate is assumed. -/
theorem original_eq_six {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z) :
    original x y z = six x y z := by
  rcases h with ⟨hz, hzy, hyx, hx⟩
  have hy : y ≤ mu := hyx.trans hx
  have hzmu : z ≤ mu := hzy.trans hy
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := hz.trans hzy
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := hy0.trans hyx
  have hb : 0 ≤ v x := by rw [v_eq_A hx]; dsimp [A]; linarith
  have hvy : v y ≤ v x := by rw [v_eq_A hy, v_eq_A hx]; dsimp [A]; linarith
  have hBy : B y ≤ B z := by dsimp [B]; linarith
  have hw₁ : max (v x) (w x y z) = max (v x) (B z) := by
    rw [w, wInner_eq_B x hy hz]
    exact max_psi_eq hb (by intro hh; simpa only [v_eq_A hx] using hh)
  have hw₂ : max (v x) (w x z y) = max (v x) (B y) := by
    rw [w, wInner_eq_B x hzmu hy0]
    exact max_psi_eq hb (by intro hh; simpa only [v_eq_A hx] using hh)
  have hp₁ : max (v x) (psi (v (x + z)) (x + 2 * y + z)) =
      max (v x) (v (x + z)) := by
    apply max_psi_eq hb
    intro hh
    have hm := xz_gate_margin ⟨hz, hzy, hyx, hx⟩ hh
    linarith
  have hp₂ : max (v x) (psi (v (y + z)) (2 * x + y + z)) =
      max (v x) (v (y + z)) := by
    apply max_psi_eq hb
    intro hh
    have hm := yz_gate_margin ⟨hz, hzy, hyx, hx⟩ hh
    linarith
  have hsplit (a b c d e f g : ℝ) :
      max (v x) (max a (max b (max c (max d (max e (max f g)))))) =
      max (max (v x) a) (max (max (v x) b) (max (max (v x) c)
        (max (max (v x) d) (max (max (v x) e)
          (max (max (v x) f) (max (v x) g)))))) := by
    repeat rw [max_base_max (v x)]
  unfold original
  rw [hsplit, max_eq_left hvy, hw₁, hw₂, hp₁, hp₂]
  unfold six
  have habs : max (B z) (B y) = B z := max_eq_left hBy
  calc
    _ = max (v x) (max (v (x + y)) (max (v (x + y + z))
        (max (max (B z) (B y)) (max (v (x + z)) (v (y + z)))))) := by
          apply le_antisymm <;> simp only [max_le_iff] <;> simp
    _ = _ := by rw [habs]

end

end ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope

import ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelopeRegularity

/-!
# Rational boxes for the actual variable envelope

The seven entries below are exactly the six `v` intervals and the `B` interval
used by `phi_range` in the prefix certificates. The extra `v(y)` is dominated
on the ordered domain. Bounds are interval proofs, not corner sampling.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope

def maxSeven {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] (a b c d e f g : α) : α :=
  max a (max b (max c (max d (max e (max f g)))))

theorem maxSeven_le_iff {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] {a b c d e f g t : α} :
    maxSeven a b c d e f g ≤ t ↔
      a ≤ t ∧ b ≤ t ∧ c ≤ t ∧ d ≤ t ∧ e ≤ t ∧ f ≤ t ∧ g ≤ t := by
  simp [maxSeven]

theorem maxSeven_mono {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]
    {a b c d e f g a' b' c' d' e' f' g' : α}
    (ha : a ≤ a') (hb : b ≤ b') (hc : c ≤ c') (hd : d ≤ d')
    (he : e ≤ e') (hf : f ≤ f') (hg : g ≤ g') :
    maxSeven a b c d e f g ≤ maxSeven a' b' c' d' e' f' g' :=
  max_le_max ha (max_le_max hb (max_le_max hc
    (max_le_max hd (max_le_max he (max_le_max hf hg)))))

theorem cast_maxSeven (a b c d e f g : ℚ) :
    ((maxSeven a b c d e f g : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      maxSeven (a : ℝ) b c d e f g := by simp [maxSeven]

theorem maxSeven_sub_le {a b c d e f g a' b' c' d' e' f' g' δ : ℚ}
    (ha : a' - a ≤ δ) (hb : b' - b ≤ δ) (hc : c' - c ≤ δ)
    (hd : d' - d ≤ δ) (he : e' - e ≤ δ) (hf : f' - f ≤ δ) (hg : g' - g ≤ δ) :
    maxSeven a' b' c' d' e' f' g' - maxSeven a b c d e f g ≤ δ := by
  have hm : maxSeven a' b' c' d' e' f' g' ≤
      maxSeven (a + δ) (b + δ) (c + δ) (d + δ) (e + δ) (f + δ) (g + δ) :=
    maxSeven_mono (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have heq : maxSeven (a + δ) (b + δ) (c + δ) (d + δ) (e + δ) (f + δ) (g + δ) =
      maxSeven a b c d e f g + δ := by simp [maxSeven, max_add_add_right]
  rw [heq] at hm
  linarith

theorem maxSeven_v_eq_original {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z) :
    maxSeven (v x) (v y) (v (x + y)) (v (x + y + z))
      (v (x + z)) (v (y + z)) (B z) = original x y z := by
  have hy : y ≤ mu := h.2.2.1.trans h.2.2.2
  have hxy : v y ≤ v x := by
    rw [v_eq_A hy, v_eq_A h.2.2.2]
    dsimp [A]; linarith [h.2.2.1]
  rw [original_eq_six h]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [maxSeven_le_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact v_le_six x y z
    · exact hxy.trans (v_le_six x y z)
    all_goals simp [six]
  · simp only [six, max_le_iff]
    all_goals simp [maxSeven]

/-- Endpoints may be unordered; feasibility is checked separately. -/
structure RationalBox where
  lx : ℚ
  ux : ℚ
  ly : ℚ
  uy : ℚ
  lz : ℚ
  uz : ℚ
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace RationalBox

def InBox (b : RationalBox) (x y z : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (b.lx : ℝ) ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b.ux ∧ (b.ly : ℝ) ≤ y ∧ y ≤ b.uy ∧
    (b.lz : ℝ) ≤ z ∧ z ≤ b.uz

def ValidPoint (b : RationalBox) (x y z : ℝ) : Prop :=
  b.InBox x y z ∧ Ordered x y z

def WellFormed (b : RationalBox) : Prop := b.lx ≤ b.ux ∧ b.ly ≤ b.uy ∧ b.lz ≤ b.uz

def lower (b : RationalBox) : ℚ :=
  maxSeven (qVLo b.lx b.ux) (qVLo b.ly b.uy)
    (qVLo (b.lx + b.ly) (b.ux + b.uy))
    (qVLo (b.lx + b.ly + b.lz) (b.ux + b.uy + b.uz))
    (qVLo (b.lx + b.lz) (b.ux + b.uz))
    (qVLo (b.ly + b.lz) (b.uy + b.uz)) (qB b.uz)

def upper (b : RationalBox) : ℚ :=
  maxSeven (qVHi b.lx b.ux) (qVHi b.ly b.uy)
    (qVHi (b.lx + b.ly) (b.ux + b.uy))
    (qVHi (b.lx + b.ly + b.lz) (b.ux + b.uy + b.uz))
    (qVHi (b.lx + b.lz) (b.ux + b.uz))
    (qVHi (b.ly + b.lz) (b.uy + b.uz)) (qB b.lz)

def width (b : RationalBox) : ℚ :=
  max 0 (max (b.ux - b.lx) (max (b.uy - b.ly) (b.uz - b.lz)))

theorem wellFormed_of_inBox {b : RationalBox} {x y z : ℝ} (h : b.InBox x y z) :
    b.WellFormed := by
  rcases h with ⟨hlx, hux, hly, huy, hlz, huz⟩
  exact ⟨Rat.cast_le.mp (hlx.trans hux), Rat.cast_le.mp (hly.trans huy),
    Rat.cast_le.mp (hlz.trans huz)⟩

theorem lower_le_original {b : RationalBox} {x y z : ℝ} (h : b.ValidPoint x y z) :
    (b.lower : ℝ) ≤ original x y z := by
  rcases h with ⟨⟨hlx, hux, hly, huy, hlz, huz⟩, ho⟩
  rw [← maxSeven_v_eq_original ho, lower, cast_maxSeven]
  apply maxSeven_mono
  · exact qVLo_le_v hlx hux
  · exact qVLo_le_v hly huy
  · apply qVLo_le_v <;> push_cast <;> linarith
  · apply qVLo_le_v <;> push_cast <;> linarith
  · apply qVLo_le_v <;> push_cast <;> linarith
  · apply qVLo_le_v <;> push_cast <;> linarith
  · rw [cast_qB]; dsimp [B]; linarith

theorem original_le_upper {b : RationalBox} {x y z : ℝ} (h : b.ValidPoint x y z) :
    original x y z ≤ (b.upper : ℝ) := by
  rcases h with ⟨⟨hlx, hux, hly, huy, hlz, huz⟩, ho⟩
  rw [← maxSeven_v_eq_original ho, upper, cast_maxSeven]
  apply maxSeven_mono
  · exact v_le_qVHi hlx hux
  · exact v_le_qVHi hly huy
  · apply v_le_qVHi <;> push_cast <;> linarith
  · apply v_le_qVHi <;> push_cast <;> linarith
  · apply v_le_qVHi <;> push_cast <;> linarith
  · apply v_le_qVHi <;> push_cast <;> linarith
  · rw [cast_qB]; dsimp [B]; linarith

theorem enclosure {b : RationalBox} {x y z : ℝ} (h : b.ValidPoint x y z) :
    (b.lower : ℝ) ≤ original x y z ∧ original x y z ≤ (b.upper : ℝ) :=
  ⟨lower_le_original h, original_le_upper h⟩

theorem width_nonneg (b : RationalBox) : 0 ≤ b.width := le_max_left _ _

theorem coordinate_widths_le (b : RationalBox) :
    b.ux - b.lx ≤ b.width ∧ b.uy - b.ly ≤ b.width ∧ b.uz - b.lz ≤ b.width := by
  simp [width]

/-- Exact rational error goes to zero linearly with the maximum side width. -/
theorem upper_sub_lower_le {b : RationalBox} (h : b.WellFormed) :
    b.upper - b.lower ≤ 9 / 2 * b.width := by
  rcases h with ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
  have hw := b.coordinate_widths_le
  have hw0 := b.width_nonneg
  unfold upper lower
  apply maxSeven_sub_le
  · have hh := qVHi_sub_qVLo_le hx; linarith [hw.1]
  · have hh := qVHi_sub_qVLo_le hy; linarith [hw.2.1]
  · have hh := qVHi_sub_qVLo_le (add_le_add hx hy); linarith [hw.1, hw.2.1]
  · have hh := qVHi_sub_qVLo_le (add_le_add (add_le_add hx hy) hz)
    linarith [hw.1, hw.2.1, hw.2.2]
  · have hh := qVHi_sub_qVLo_le (add_le_add hx hz); linarith [hw.1, hw.2.2]
  · have hh := qVHi_sub_qVLo_le (add_le_add hy hz); linarith [hw.2.1, hw.2.2]
  · dsimp [qB]; linarith [hw.2.2]

theorem enclosure_error {b : RationalBox} {x y z : ℝ} (h : b.ValidPoint x y z) :
    0 ≤ original x y z - b.lower ∧
    original x y z - b.lower ≤ (9 / 2 : ℝ) * b.width ∧
    0 ≤ (b.upper : ℝ) - original x y z ∧
    (b.upper : ℝ) - original x y z ≤ (9 / 2 : ℝ) * b.width := by
  have hl := lower_le_original h
  have hu := original_le_upper h
  have he : (b.upper : ℝ) - b.lower ≤ (9 / 2 : ℝ) * b.width := by
    have hh := Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ) |>.mpr (upper_sub_lower_le (wellFormed_of_inBox h.1))
    norm_num at hh ⊢
    exact hh
  constructor
  · linarith
  constructor
  · linarith
  constructor <;> linarith

/-- An explicit epsilon form, including zero-width boxes. -/
theorem error_lt_of_width_lt {b : RationalBox} {x y z ε : ℝ}
    (h : b.ValidPoint x y z) (hw : (b.width : ℝ) < 2 / 9 * ε) :
    original x y z - b.lower < ε ∧ (b.upper : ℝ) - original x y z < ε := by
  have he := enclosure_error h
  constructor <;> linarith [he.2.1, he.2.2.2]

def witnessZ (b : RationalBox) : ℚ := max 0 b.lz
def witnessY (b : RationalBox) : ℚ := max b.witnessZ b.ly
def witnessX (b : RationalBox) : ℚ := max b.witnessY b.lx

/-- A finite rational feasibility test; it constructs an actual ordered point. -/
def feasible (b : RationalBox) : Bool :=
  decide (b.witnessZ ≤ b.uz ∧ b.witnessY ≤ b.uy ∧
    b.witnessX ≤ b.ux ∧ b.witnessX ≤ 25 / 128)

theorem feasible_sound {b : RationalBox} (h : b.feasible = true) :
    b.ValidPoint b.witnessX b.witnessY b.witnessZ := by
  have hh : b.witnessZ ≤ b.uz ∧ b.witnessY ≤ b.uy ∧
      b.witnessX ≤ b.ux ∧ b.witnessX ≤ 25 / 128 := by simpa [feasible] using h
  have hz0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ b.witnessZ := le_max_left _ _
  have hzy : b.witnessZ ≤ b.witnessY := le_max_left _ _
  have hyx : b.witnessY ≤ b.witnessX := le_max_left _ _
  have hlx : b.lx ≤ b.witnessX := le_max_right _ _
  have hly : b.ly ≤ b.witnessY := le_max_right _ _
  have hlz : b.lz ≤ b.witnessZ := le_max_right _ _
  constructor
  · exact ⟨Rat.cast_le.mpr hlx, Rat.cast_le.mpr hh.2.2.1,
      Rat.cast_le.mpr hly, Rat.cast_le.mpr hh.2.1,
      Rat.cast_le.mpr hlz, Rat.cast_le.mpr hh.1⟩
  · refine ⟨?_, Rat.cast_le.mpr hzy, Rat.cast_le.mpr hyx, ?_⟩
    · exact_mod_cast hz0
    · have hc := Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ) |>.mpr hh.2.2.2
      norm_num [mu] at hc ⊢
      exact hc

theorem feasible_complete {b : RationalBox} {x y z : ℝ} (h : b.ValidPoint x y z) :
    b.feasible = true := by
  rcases h with ⟨⟨hlx, hux, hly, huy, hlz, huz⟩, hz0, hzy, hyx, hxmu⟩
  have hwz : (b.witnessZ : ℝ) ≤ z := by
    simp only [witnessZ, Rat.cast_max, Rat.cast_zero]
    exact max_le hz0 hlz
  have hwy : (b.witnessY : ℝ) ≤ y := by
    simp only [witnessY, Rat.cast_max]
    exact max_le (hwz.trans hzy) hly
  have hwx : (b.witnessX : ℝ) ≤ x := by
    simp only [witnessX, Rat.cast_max]
    exact max_le (hwy.trans hyx) hlx
  have hmu : b.witnessX ≤ (25 / 128 : ℚ) := by
    have hh := hwx.trans hxmu
    dsimp [mu] at hh
    apply Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ) |>.mp
    norm_num
    exact hh
  simpa only [feasible, decide_eq_true_eq] using
    And.intro (Rat.cast_le.mp (hwz.trans huz))
      ⟨Rat.cast_le.mp (hwy.trans huy), Rat.cast_le.mp (hwx.trans hux), hmu⟩

theorem feasible_iff (b : RationalBox) :
    b.feasible = true ↔ ∃ x y z : ℝ, b.ValidPoint x y z := by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨_, _, _, feasible_sound h⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y, z, h⟩; exact feasible_complete h

/-- A successful margin certificate always certifies a nonempty effective box. -/
def marginCheck (b : RationalBox) (η : ℚ) : Bool :=
  b.feasible && decide (0 < b.lower - 3 * b.ux - η)

theorem margin_of_rational_check {b : RationalBox} {η : ℚ}
    (hc : 0 < b.lower - 3 * b.ux - η) {x y z : ℝ} (h : b.ValidPoint x y z) :
    0 < original x y z - 3 * x - η := by
  have hcr : (0 : ℝ) < b.lower - 3 * (b.ux : ℝ) - η := by exact_mod_cast hc
  have hl := lower_le_original h
  have hx := h.1.2.1
  linarith

theorem marginCheck_sound {b : RationalBox} {η : ℚ} (h : b.marginCheck η = true) :
    (∃ x y z : ℝ, b.ValidPoint x y z) ∧
      ∀ x y z : ℝ, b.ValidPoint x y z → 0 < original x y z - 3 * x - η := by
  have hh : b.feasible = true ∧ 0 < b.lower - 3 * b.ux - η := by
    simpa [marginCheck] using h
  exact ⟨(feasible_iff b).mp hh.1, fun _ _ _ hp => margin_of_rational_check hh.2 hp⟩

theorem marginCheck_false_of_empty {b : RationalBox}
    (h : ¬ ∃ x y z : ℝ, b.ValidPoint x y z) (η : ℚ) : b.marginCheck η = false := by
  have hf : b.feasible = false := by
    cases hb : b.feasible
    · rfl
    · exact False.elim (h ((feasible_iff b).mp hb))
  simp [marginCheck, hf]

end RationalBox

/-!
# Continuity and quantitative bounds for the variable envelope

The six-branch expression is continuous on all of `ℝ³`. The equality with
the literal gated expression therefore supplies continuity on the closed
ordered domain. The bounds below use the actual branches proved in
`VariableEnvelope`, without assuming any analytic or sieve estimate.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope

noncomputable section

theorem continuous_A : Continuous A := by
  exact (continuous_const.add continuous_id).div_const 2

theorem continuous_C : Continuous C := by
  exact continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)

theorem continuous_B : Continuous B := by
  exact continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)

theorem continuous_v : Continuous v := by
  change Continuous (fun t : ℝ => v t)
  simp only [v_eq_min]
  exact continuous_A.min continuous_C

/-- The six-branch formula itself is continuous without domain restrictions. -/
theorem continuous_six : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => six p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) := by
  have hx : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => p.1) := continuous_fst
  have hy : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => p.2.1) :=
    continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd
  have hz : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => p.2.2) :=
    continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd
  unfold six
  exact (continuous_v.comp hx).max
    ((continuous_v.comp (hx.add hy)).max
      ((continuous_v.comp ((hx.add hy).add hz)).max
        ((continuous_B.comp hz).max
          ((continuous_v.comp (hx.add hz)).max (continuous_v.comp (hy.add hz))))))

/-- The domain includes all its boundary faces, including `z = 0`. -/
def orderedSet : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {p | Ordered p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2}

theorem isClosed_orderedSet : IsClosed orderedSet := by
  have hx : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => p.1) := continuous_fst
  have hy : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => p.2.1) :=
    continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd
  have hz : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => p.2.2) :=
    continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd
  exact (isClosed_le continuous_const hz).inter
    ((isClosed_le hz hy).inter ((isClosed_le hy hx).inter (isClosed_le hx continuous_const)))

/-- The gated formula is continuous relative to the closed ordered domain. -/
theorem continuousOn_original :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => original p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) orderedSet := by
  apply continuous_six.continuousOn.congr
  intro p hp
  exact original_eq_six hp

theorem v_le_six (x y z : ℝ) : v x ≤ six x y z := by
  exact le_max_left _ _

theorem B_le_six (x y z : ℝ) : B z ≤ six x y z := by
  exact le_max_of_le_right (le_max_of_le_right (le_max_of_le_right (le_max_left _ _)))

theorem six_le_cap (x y : ℝ) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) : six x y z ≤ cap := by
  have hB : B z ≤ cap := by dsimp [B]; linarith
  exact max_le (v_le_cap _) (max_le (v_le_cap _) (max_le (v_le_cap _)
    (max_le hB (max_le (v_le_cap _) (v_le_cap _)))))

theorem v_le_original {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z) : v x ≤ original x y z := by
  rw [original_eq_six h]
  exact v_le_six x y z

theorem B_le_original {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z) : B z ≤ original x y z := by
  rw [original_eq_six h]
  exact B_le_six x y z

theorem original_le_cap {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z) : original x y z ≤ cap := by
  rw [original_eq_six h]
  exact six_le_cap x y h.1

/-- The strict surplus has the uniform, sharp lower bound `3/256`. -/
theorem original_margin {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z) :
    3 / 256 ≤ original x y z - 3 * x := by
  have hv := v_le_original h
  rw [v_eq_A h.2.2.2] at hv
  have hx := h.2.2.2
  dsimp [A, mu] at *
  linarith

theorem three_mul_lt_original {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z) :
    3 * x < original x y z := by
  have hm := original_margin h
  linarith

theorem original_margin_pos {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z) :
    0 < original x y z - 3 * x := by
  have hm := original_margin h
  linarith

/-- The affine branch gives the manuscript's threshold criterion. -/
theorem threshold_le_original {x y z Theta : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z)
    (hz : z ≤ (8 / 3) * (cap - Theta)) : Theta ≤ original x y z := by
  have hb := B_le_original h
  dsimp [B] at hb
  linarith

theorem cutoff_597 : (8 / 3 : ℝ) * (cap - 597 / 1000) = 7 / 4000 := by
  norm_num [cap]

theorem threshold_597_le_original {x y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered x y z)
    (hz : z ≤ 7 / 4000) : (597 / 1000 : ℝ) ≤ original x y z := by
  apply threshold_le_original h
  simpa only [cutoff_597] using hz

theorem ordered_mu : Ordered mu mu mu := by
  norm_num [Ordered, mu]

/-- The envelope reaches its cap on the whole face `x = mu`. -/
theorem original_mu_left {y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered mu y z) : original mu y z = cap := by
  apply le_antisymm (original_le_cap h)
  calc
    cap = A mu := by norm_num [cap, A, mu]
    _ = v mu := (v_eq_A (le_refl mu)).symm
    _ ≤ original mu y z := v_le_original h

theorem original_mu : original mu mu mu = cap := original_mu_left ordered_mu

theorem original_margin_eq_on_mu {y z : ℝ} (h : Ordered mu y z) :
    original mu y z - 3 * mu = 3 / 256 := by
  rw [original_mu_left h]
  norm_num [cap, mu]

/-- Equality at the positive diagonal point shows that the margin cannot be improved. -/
theorem original_margin_sharp : original mu mu mu - 3 * mu = 3 / 256 := by
  rw [original_mu]
  norm_num [cap, mu]

/-- The second pair gate also attains the uniform margin at a point with positive `z`. -/
theorem yz_gate_margin_sharp :
    v (mu / 2 + mu / 2) - (2 * mu + mu / 2 + mu / 2) = 3 / 256 := by
  have hs : mu / 2 + mu / 2 = mu := by linarith
  rw [hs, v_eq_A (le_refl mu)]
  norm_num [A, mu]

end

end ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope

/-!
# Rational interval bounds and regularity of the variable envelope

The rational scalar interfaces retain the affine expressions used by the
prefix certificates. Bounds hold throughout an interval, including intervals
that cross the peak of `v`. The six-branch regularity results below use no
ordering assumptions; returning to the gated expression requires `Ordered`.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope

def qA (t : ℚ) : ℚ := (1 + t) / 2
def qC (t : ℚ) : ℚ := 57 / 64 - 3 / 2 * t
def qB (t : ℚ) : ℚ := 153 / 256 - 3 / 8 * t
def qV (t : ℚ) : ℚ := min (qA t) (qC t)
def qVLo (l u : ℚ) : ℚ := min (qA l) (qC u)
def qVHi (l u : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  if l ≤ 25 / 128 ∧ 25 / 128 ≤ u then 153 / 256 else max (qV l) (qV u)

theorem cast_qA (t : ℚ) : (qA t : ℝ) = A t := by
  simp [qA, A]

theorem cast_qC (t : ℚ) : (qC t : ℝ) = C t := by
  simp [qC, C]

theorem cast_qB (t : ℚ) : (qB t : ℝ) = B t := by
  simp [qB, B, cap]

theorem cast_qV (t : ℚ) : (qV t : ℝ) = v t := by
  simp [qV, v_eq_min, cast_qA, cast_qC]

theorem cast_qVLo (l u : ℚ) : (qVLo l u : ℝ) = min (A l) (C u) := by
  simp [qVLo, cast_qA, cast_qC]

theorem qVLo_le_v {l u : ℚ} {t : ℝ} (hl : (l : ℝ) ≤ t) (hu : t ≤ (u : ℝ)) :
    (qVLo l u : ℝ) ≤ v t := by
  rw [cast_qVLo, v_eq_min]
  apply min_le_min
  · dsimp [A]; linarith
  · dsimp [C]; linarith

theorem v_le_qVHi {l u : ℚ} {t : ℝ} (hl : (l : ℝ) ≤ t) (hu : t ≤ (u : ℝ)) :
    v t ≤ (qVHi l u : ℝ) := by
  unfold qVHi
  split_ifs with h
  · simpa [cap] using v_le_cap t
  · simp only [Rat.cast_max, cast_qV]
    by_cases hlu : u ≤ 25 / 128
    · have hur : (u : ℝ) ≤ mu := by
        have hh : (u : ℝ) ≤ ((25 / 128 : ℚ) : ℝ) := Rat.cast_le.mpr hlu
        norm_num [mu] at hh ⊢
        exact hh
      rw [v_eq_A (hu.trans hur), v_eq_A hur]
      apply le_max_of_le_right
      dsimp [A]; linarith
    · have hll : (25 / 128 : ℚ) < l := by
        have hmu : (25 / 128 : ℚ) ≤ u := le_of_not_ge hlu
        exact lt_of_not_ge (fun hh => h ⟨hh, hmu⟩)
      have hlr : mu ≤ (l : ℝ) := by
        have hh : ((25 / 128 : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ (l : ℝ) := Rat.cast_le.mpr (le_of_lt hll)
        norm_num [mu] at hh ⊢
        exact hh
      rw [v_eq_C (hlr.trans hl), v_eq_C hlr]
      apply le_max_of_le_left
      dsimp [C]; linarith

theorem qV_eq_qA {t : ℚ} (h : t ≤ 25 / 128) : qV t = qA t := by
  apply min_eq_left
  dsimp [qA, qC]; linarith

theorem qV_eq_qC {t : ℚ} (h : 25 / 128 ≤ t) : qV t = qC t := by
  apply min_eq_right
  dsimp [qA, qC]; linarith

/-- The interval enclosure shrinks at most linearly, even when it crosses `mu`. -/
theorem qVHi_sub_qVLo_le {l u : ℚ} (hlu : l ≤ u) :
    qVHi l u - qVLo l u ≤ 3 / 2 * (u - l) := by
  unfold qVHi qVLo
  split_ifs with h
  · rcases h with ⟨hl, hu⟩
    rcases le_total (qA l) (qC u) with ha | hc
    · rw [min_eq_left ha]; dsimp [qA]; linarith
    · rw [min_eq_right hc]; dsimp [qC]; linarith
  · by_cases hu : u ≤ 25 / 128
    · rw [qV_eq_qA (hlu.trans hu), qV_eq_qA hu]
      have hmono : qA l ≤ qA u := by dsimp [qA]; linarith
      have hsmall : qA l ≤ qC u := by dsimp [qA, qC]; linarith
      rw [max_eq_right hmono, min_eq_left hsmall]
      dsimp [qA]; linarith
    · have hl : (25 / 128 : ℚ) ≤ l := by
        exact le_of_not_ge (fun hh => h ⟨hh, le_of_not_ge hu⟩)
      rw [qV_eq_qC hl, qV_eq_qC (hl.trans hlu)]
      have hmono : qC u ≤ qC l := by dsimp [qC]; linarith
      have hsmall : qC u ≤ qA l := by dsimp [qA, qC]; linarith
      rw [max_eq_left hmono, min_eq_right hsmall]
      dsimp [qC]; linarith

private theorem abs_min_sub_min_le {a b c e d : ℝ}
    (hac : |a - c| ≤ d) (hbe : |b - e| ≤ d) :
    |min a b - min c e| ≤ d := by
  exact (_root_.abs_min_sub_min_le_max a b c e).trans (max_le hac hbe)

private theorem abs_max_sub_max_le {a b c e d : ℝ}
    (hac : |a - c| ≤ d) (hbe : |b - e| ≤ d) :
    |max a b - max c e| ≤ d := by
  exact (_root_.abs_max_sub_max_le_max a b c e).trans (max_le hac hbe)

/-- The scalar tent has Lipschitz constant `3/2`, globally. -/
theorem v_abs_sub_le_of_le {s t d : ℝ} (h : |s - t| ≤ d) :
    |v s - v t| ≤ 3 / 2 * d := by
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := (abs_nonneg _).trans h
  rcases abs_le.mp h with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  rw [v_eq_min, v_eq_min]
  apply abs_min_sub_min_le
  · apply abs_le.mpr; dsimp [A]; constructor <;> linarith
  · apply abs_le.mpr; dsimp [C]; constructor <;> linarith

theorem v_abs_sub_le (s t : ℝ) : |v s - v t| ≤ 3 / 2 * |s - t| :=
  v_abs_sub_le_of_le (le_refl _)

/-- A common coordinate error gives a global `9/2` bound for all six branches. -/
theorem six_abs_sub_le {x y z x' y' z' d : ℝ}
    (hx : |x - x'| ≤ d) (hy : |y - y'| ≤ d) (hz : |z - z'| ≤ d) :
    |six x y z - six x' y' z'| ≤ 9 / 2 * d := by
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := (abs_nonneg _).trans hx
  have hxy : |(x + y) - (x' + y')| ≤ 2 * d := by
    rcases abs_le.mp hx with ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hy with ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩
    apply abs_le.mpr; constructor <;> linarith
  have hxyz : |(x + y + z) - (x' + y' + z')| ≤ 3 * d := by
    rcases abs_le.mp hxy with ⟨hxy₁, hxy₂⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hz with ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩
    apply abs_le.mpr; constructor <;> linarith
  have hxz : |(x + z) - (x' + z')| ≤ 2 * d := by
    rcases abs_le.mp hx with ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hz with ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩
    apply abs_le.mpr; constructor <;> linarith
  have hyz : |(y + z) - (y' + z')| ≤ 2 * d := by
    rcases abs_le.mp hy with ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hz with ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩
    apply abs_le.mpr; constructor <;> linarith
  have h₁ : |v x - v x'| ≤ 9 / 2 * d := by
    have := v_abs_sub_le_of_le hx; linarith
  have h₂ : |v (x + y) - v (x' + y')| ≤ 9 / 2 * d := by
    have := v_abs_sub_le_of_le hxy; linarith
  have h₃ : |v (x + y + z) - v (x' + y' + z')| ≤ 9 / 2 * d := by
    have := v_abs_sub_le_of_le hxyz; linarith
  have h₄ : |B z - B z'| ≤ 9 / 2 * d := by
    rcases abs_le.mp hz with ⟨hz₁, hz₂⟩
    apply abs_le.mpr; dsimp [B]; constructor <;> linarith
  have h₅ : |v (x + z) - v (x' + z')| ≤ 9 / 2 * d := by
    have := v_abs_sub_le_of_le hxz; linarith
  have h₆ : |v (y + z) - v (y' + z')| ≤ 9 / 2 * d := by
    have := v_abs_sub_le_of_le hyz; linarith
  exact abs_max_sub_max_le h₁ (abs_max_sub_max_le h₂ (abs_max_sub_max_le h₃
    (abs_max_sub_max_le h₄ (abs_max_sub_max_le h₅ h₆))))

/-- Explicit Lipschitz inequality for the maximum coordinate distance. -/
theorem six_lipschitz_max (x y z x' y' z' : ℝ) :
    |six x y z - six x' y' z'| ≤
      9 / 2 * max |x - x'| (max |y - y'| |z - z'|) := by
  apply six_abs_sub_le
  · exact le_max_left _ _
  · exact le_max_of_le_right (le_max_left _ _)
  · exact le_max_of_le_right (le_max_right _ _)

/-- The gated formula inherits the bound when both points satisfy the proved domain. -/
theorem original_abs_sub_le {x y z x' y' z' d : ℝ}
    (h : Ordered x y z) (h' : Ordered x' y' z')
    (hx : |x - x'| ≤ d) (hy : |y - y'| ≤ d) (hz : |z - z'| ≤ d) :
    |original x y z - original x' y' z'| ≤ 9 / 2 * d := by
  rw [original_eq_six h, original_eq_six h']
  exact six_abs_sub_le hx hy hz

theorem original_lipschitz_max {x y z x' y' z' : ℝ}
    (h : Ordered x y z) (h' : Ordered x' y' z') :
    |original x y z - original x' y' z'| ≤
      9 / 2 * max |x - x'| (max |y - y'| |z - z'|) := by
  rw [original_eq_six h, original_eq_six h']
  exact six_lipschitz_max x y z x' y' z'

import ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelopeRegularity

/-!
# Integer-scaled bounds used by the existing variable-prefix certificates

The division in this module is integer Euclidean division. All denominators
are positive, so it is exactly Python's `//`; `ceilDiv` is the certificate's
`-((-n)//d)`, including when the numerator is negative. The crossing integer
must satisfy `128 * M = 25 * D`. No extension beyond the original VE domain
is asserted here.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope

/-- Exact signed ceiling division from the existing certificate scripts. -/
def ceilDiv (n d : ℤ) : ℤ := -((-n) / d)

/-- The certificate's `v_lo`, retaining the downward integer rounding. -/
def scaledVLo (D l u : ℤ) : ℤ := min ((D + l) / 2) ((57 * D - 96 * u) / 64)

/-- The certificate's `v_point_hi`, retaining the upward integer rounding. -/
def scaledVPointHi (D t : ℤ) : ℤ :=
  min (ceilDiv (D + t) 2) (ceilDiv (57 * D - 96 * t) 64)

/-- The certificate's `v_hi`, with both crossing endpoints included. -/
def scaledVHi (D M l u : ℤ) : ℤ :=
  if l ≤ M ∧ M ≤ u then ceilDiv (153 * D) 256
  else max (scaledVPointHi D l) (scaledVPointHi D u)

def scaledBLo (D u : ℤ) : ℤ := (153 * D - 96 * u) / 256

def scaledBHi (D l : ℤ) : ℤ := ceilDiv (153 * D - 96 * l) 256

/-- Euclidean division rounds down, with an error strictly less than one. -/
theorem floorDiv_bounds (n d : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ((n / d : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) / d ∧
    (n : ℝ) / d < ((n / d : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hlo : (n / d : ℤ) * d ≤ n := Int.ediv_mul_le n (ne_of_gt hd)
  have hhi : n < (n / d + 1) * d := by
    have hr := Int.emod_lt_of_pos n hd
    have he := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv n d
    nlinarith
  constructor
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ hdR).2
    exact_mod_cast hlo
  · apply (div_lt_iff₀ hdR).2
    exact_mod_cast hhi

/-- Signed ceiling division rounds up, with an error strictly less than one. -/
theorem ceilDiv_bounds (n d : ℤ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (n : ℝ) / d ≤ (ceilDiv n d : ℝ) ∧
    (ceilDiv n d : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) / d + 1 := by
  have h := floorDiv_bounds (-n) d hd
  dsimp [ceilDiv]
  push_cast at *
  simp only [neg_div] at h
  constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]

/-- Both active affine branches are bounded by their correctly rounded interval endpoints. -/
theorem scaled_v_lower (D l u : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) {t : ℝ}
    (hl : (l : ℝ) ≤ D * t) (hu : D * t ≤ u) :
    (scaledVLo D l u : ℝ) ≤ D * v t := by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hD
  have ha := (floorDiv_bounds (D + l) 2 (by norm_num)).1
  have hc := (floorDiv_bounds (57 * D - 96 * u) 64 (by norm_num)).1
  push_cast at ha hc
  rw [v_eq_min, mul_min_of_nonneg _ _ hD0, scaledVLo, Int.cast_min]
  apply le_min
  · have hm := min_le_left (((D + l) / 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) (((57 * D - 96 * u) / 64 : ℤ) : ℝ)
    dsimp [A]
    nlinarith
  · have hm := min_le_right (((D + l) / 2 : ℤ) : ℝ) (((57 * D - 96 * u) / 64 : ℤ) : ℝ)
    dsimp [C]
    nlinarith

/-- The crossing test and endpoint maxima bound every real point of the interval. -/
theorem scaled_v_upper (D M l u : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) {t : ℝ}
    (hl : (l : ℝ) ≤ D * t) (hu : D * t ≤ u) :
    D * v t ≤ (scaledVHi D M l u : ℝ) := by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hD
  have hMR : (128 : ℝ) * M = 25 * D := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hcap := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (v_le_cap t) hD0
  have hA := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show v t ≤ A t by rw [v_eq_min]; exact min_le_left _ _) hD0
  have hC := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show v t ≤ C t by rw [v_eq_min]; exact min_le_right _ _) hD0
  dsimp [A, C, cap] at hcap hA hC
  unfold scaledVHi
  split_ifs with hcross
  · have hc := (ceilDiv_bounds (153 * D) 256 (by norm_num)).1
    push_cast at hc
    nlinarith
  · by_cases hleft : u < M
    · have hleftR : (u : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hleft
      apply le_trans _ (show (scaledVPointHi D u : ℝ) ≤ ↑(max (scaledVPointHi D l) (scaledVPointHi D u)) by
        rw [Int.cast_max]; exact le_max_right _ _)
      rw [scaledVPointHi, Int.cast_min]
      have ha := (ceilDiv_bounds (D + u) 2 (by norm_num)).1
      have hc := (ceilDiv_bounds (57 * D - 96 * u) 64 (by norm_num)).1
      push_cast at ha hc
      exact le_min (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)
    · have hright : M < l := by omega
      have hrightR : (M : ℝ) < l := by exact_mod_cast hright
      apply le_trans _ (show (scaledVPointHi D l : ℝ) ≤ ↑(max (scaledVPointHi D l) (scaledVPointHi D u)) by
        rw [Int.cast_max]; exact le_max_left _ _)
      rw [scaledVPointHi, Int.cast_min]
      have ha := (ceilDiv_bounds (D + l) 2 (by norm_num)).1
      have hc := (ceilDiv_bounds (57 * D - 96 * l) 64 (by norm_num)).1
      push_cast at ha hc
      exact le_min (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)

/-- Soundness of the exact old `v_lo` / `v_hi` integer algorithm. -/
theorem scaled_v_bounds (D M l u : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) {t : ℝ}
    (hl : (l : ℝ) ≤ D * t) (hu : D * t ≤ u) :
    (scaledVLo D l u : ℝ) ≤ D * v t ∧
    D * v t ≤ (scaledVHi D M l u : ℝ) :=
  ⟨scaled_v_lower D l u hD hl hu, scaled_v_upper D M l u hD hM hl hu⟩

/-- The decreasing B branch uses the upper box endpoint for its lower bound. -/
theorem scaled_B_bounds (D l u : ℤ) {t : ℝ}
    (hl : (l : ℝ) ≤ D * t) (hu : D * t ≤ u) :
    (scaledBLo D u : ℝ) ≤ D * B t ∧
    D * B t ≤ (scaledBHi D l : ℝ) := by
  have hlo := (floorDiv_bounds (153 * D - 96 * u) 256 (by norm_num)).1
  have hhi := (ceilDiv_bounds (153 * D - 96 * l) 256 (by norm_num)).1
  push_cast at hlo hhi
  dsimp [scaledBLo, scaledBHi, B, cap]
  constructor <;> nlinarith




/-- Scaling the normalized rational A branch gives the script's exact numerator. -/
theorem scaled_qA (D t : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (D : ℝ) * (qA ((t : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) = ((D : ℝ) + t) / 2 := by
  have hD0 : (D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hD
  simp only [cast_qA, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast, A]
  field_simp

/-- Scaling the normalized rational C branch gives the script's exact numerator. -/
theorem scaled_qC (D t : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (D : ℝ) * (qC ((t : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) = (57 * (D : ℝ) - 96 * t) / 64 := by
  have hD0 : (D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hD
  simp only [cast_qC, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast, C]
  field_simp
  ring

/-- Scaling the normalized rational B branch gives the script's exact numerator. -/
theorem scaled_qB (D t : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (D : ℝ) * (qB ((t : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) = (153 * (D : ℝ) - 96 * t) / 256 := by
  have hD0 : (D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hD
  simp only [cast_qB, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast, B, cap]
  field_simp
  ring

/-- The integer lower bound is within one scaled unit of the rational lower bound. -/
theorem scaledVLo_rounding (D l u : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (scaledVLo D l u : ℝ) ≤ D * (qVLo ((l : ℚ) / D) ((u : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) ∧
    D * (qVLo ((l : ℚ) / D) ((u : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) ≤ (scaledVLo D l u : ℝ) + 1 := by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hD
  have ha := floorDiv_bounds (D + l) 2 (by norm_num)
  have hc := floorDiv_bounds (57 * D - 96 * u) 64 (by norm_num)
  push_cast at ha hc
  simp only [qVLo, Rat.cast_min, mul_min_of_nonneg _ _ hD0,
    scaled_qA D l hD, scaled_qC D u hD, scaledVLo, Int.cast_min]
  constructor
  · exact min_le_min ha.1 hc.1
  · simpa only [min_add_add_right] using min_le_min (le_of_lt ha.2) (le_of_lt hc.2)

/-- The endpoint upper bound is within one scaled unit of the exact rational value. -/
theorem scaledVPointHi_rounding (D t : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    D * (qV ((t : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) ≤ (scaledVPointHi D t : ℝ) ∧
    (scaledVPointHi D t : ℝ) ≤ D * (qV ((t : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) + 1 := by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hD
  have ha := ceilDiv_bounds (D + t) 2 (by norm_num)
  have hc := ceilDiv_bounds (57 * D - 96 * t) 64 (by norm_num)
  push_cast at ha hc
  simp only [qV, Rat.cast_min, mul_min_of_nonneg _ _ hD0,
    scaled_qA D t hD, scaled_qC D t hD, scaledVPointHi, Int.cast_min]
  constructor
  · exact min_le_min ha.1 hc.1
  · simpa only [min_add_add_right] using min_le_min (le_of_lt ha.2) (le_of_lt hc.2)

/-- The script's integer crossing test is exactly the normalized rational crossing test. -/
theorem scaled_crossing_iff (D M l u : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) :
    ((l : ℚ) / D ≤ 25 / 128 ∧ 25 / 128 ≤ (u : ℚ) / D) ↔ l ≤ M ∧ M ≤ u := by
  have hDQ : (0 : ℚ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hMQ : (128 : ℚ) * M = 25 * D := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hmu : (25 / 128 : ℚ) * D = M := by linarith
  simp only [div_le_iff₀ hDQ, le_div_iff₀ hDQ, hmu]
  norm_cast

/-- The exact old upper algorithm is at most one scaled unit above the rational bound. -/
theorem scaledVHi_rounding (D M l u : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) (hM : 128 * M = 25 * D) :
    D * (qVHi ((l : ℚ) / D) ((u : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) ≤ (scaledVHi D M l u : ℝ) ∧
    (scaledVHi D M l u : ℝ) ≤ D * (qVHi ((l : ℚ) / D) ((u : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) + 1 := by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hD
  unfold qVHi scaledVHi
  by_cases hcross : l ≤ M ∧ M ≤ u
  · have hcrossQ := (scaled_crossing_iff D M l u hD hM).2 hcross
    simp only [if_pos hcross, if_pos hcrossQ]
    have hh := ceilDiv_bounds (153 * D) 256 (by norm_num)
    push_cast at hh ⊢
    constructor <;> nlinarith [hh.1, hh.2]
  · have hcrossQ : ¬ ((l : ℚ) / D ≤ 25 / 128 ∧ 25 / 128 ≤ (u : ℚ) / D) :=
      fun h => hcross ((scaled_crossing_iff D M l u hD hM).1 h)
    simp only [if_neg hcross, if_neg hcrossQ, Rat.cast_max, Int.cast_max,
      mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ hD0]
    have hl := scaledVPointHi_rounding D l hD
    have hu := scaledVPointHi_rounding D u hD
    constructor
    · exact max_le_max hl.1 hu.1
    · simpa only [max_add_add_right] using max_le_max hl.2 hu.2

/-- The rounded lower B endpoint has error at most one scaled unit. -/
theorem scaledBLo_rounding (D u : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (scaledBLo D u : ℝ) ≤ D * (qB ((u : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) ∧
    D * (qB ((u : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) ≤ (scaledBLo D u : ℝ) + 1 := by
  rw [scaled_qB D u hD]
  have hh := floorDiv_bounds (153 * D - 96 * u) 256 (by norm_num)
  push_cast at hh
  exact ⟨hh.1, le_of_lt hh.2⟩

/-- The rounded upper B endpoint has error at most one scaled unit. -/
theorem scaledBHi_rounding (D l : ℤ) (hD : 0 < D) :
    D * (qB ((l : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) ≤ (scaledBHi D l : ℝ) ∧
    (scaledBHi D l : ℝ) ≤ D * (qB ((l : ℚ) / D) : ℝ) + 1 := by
  rw [scaled_qB D l hD]
  have hh := ceilDiv_bounds (153 * D - 96 * l) 256 (by norm_num)
  push_cast at hh
  exact ⟨hh.1, le_of_lt hh.2⟩

end ImbalancedChen.VariableEnvelope
